-- ObbyConfig : tous les réglages du kit Obby / Glass Bridge.
-- Partagé client + serveur (ReplicatedStorage) : n'y mets AUCUN secret.

local ObbyConfig = {}

-- Pont de verre ------------------------------------------------------------
ObbyConfig.GlassRows = 10              -- nombre de rangées (2 vitres par rangée)
ObbyConfig.GlassSize = Vector3.new(7, 0.6, 7)
ObbyConfig.GlassGap = 4                -- espace (studs) entre deux rangées
ObbyConfig.GlassSideOffset = 5         -- distance gauche/droite depuis le centre
ObbyConfig.GlassColor = Color3.fromRGB(170, 220, 255)
ObbyConfig.GlassTransparency = 0.45
ObbyConfig.GlassBreakSound = "rbxasset://sounds/glassbreak.wav"

-- Manche -------------------------------------------------------------------
ObbyConfig.RoundDuration = 180         -- secondes ; à la fin : nouveau motif de verre
ObbyConfig.ResetPlayersOnNewRound = true -- renvoie tout le monde au départ à chaque manche

-- Récompenses ---------------------------------------------------------------
ObbyConfig.WinsPerVictory = 1
ObbyConfig.WinCooldown = 3             -- anti double-déclenchement (secondes)

-- Monétisation --------------------------------------------------------------
-- Developer Product "Skip stage" (0 = désactivé, le bouton est caché)
ObbyConfig.SkipStageProductId = 0
-- Mettre false si ton jeu a déjà un ProcessReceipt : appelle alors
-- ObbyService.HandleReceipt(receiptInfo) depuis ton propre handler.
ObbyConfig.OwnProcessReceipt = true

-- Sauvegarde ------------------------------------------------------------------
ObbyConfig.DataStoreName = "KIT_Obby_Wins_v1"
ObbyConfig.AutoSaveInterval = 120

return ObbyConfig

-- GlassBridge : génère le pont de verre entre deux repères (GlassStart -> GlassEnd).
-- Chaque rangée = 2 vitres identiques visuellement ; l'une casse.
-- Le motif n'existe QUE côté serveur (table locale) : rien de répliqué ne le trahit.

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("KIT_Obby"):WaitForChild("ObbyConfig"))

local GlassBridge = {}
GlassBridge.__index = GlassBridge

local rng = Random.new()

local function makePart(name, size, cframe, parent)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cframe
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function getCharacterFromPart(part)
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
		return nil
	end
	return model
end

local function playBreakEffect(panel)
	local sound = panel:FindFirstChild("BreakSound")
	if sound then
		sound:Play()
	end
	local emitter = panel:FindFirstChild("Shards", true)
	if emitter then
		emitter:Emit(30)
	end
	-- quelques éclats physiques
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local shard = Instance.new("Part")
		shard.Name = "GlassShard"
		shard.Size = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(0.6, 1.6), 0.2, rng:NextNumber(0.6, 1.6))
		shard.CFrame = panel.CFrame
			* CFrame.new(rng:NextNumber(-2.5, 2.5), 0, rng:NextNumber(-2.5, 2.5))
			* CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), rng:NextNumber(0, 6.28), 0)
		shard.Color = Config.GlassColor
		shard.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
		shard.Transparency = 0.3
		shard.CanCollide = false
		shard.CanTouch = false
		shard.CanQuery = false
		shard.Anchored = false
		shard.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-12, 12), rng:NextNumber(5, 15), rng:NextNumber(-12, 12))
		shard.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(shard, 2.5)
	end
end

function GlassBridge.new(bridgeFolder)
	local self = setmetatable({}, GlassBridge)
	self.Folder = bridgeFolder
	self.StartMarker = bridgeFolder:WaitForChild("GlassStart")
	self.EndMarker = bridgeFolder:WaitForChild("GlassEnd")
	self.Panels = {}   -- liste de toutes les vitres
	self.Fragile = {}  -- [panel] = true si elle casse (serveur uniquement)
	self.Broken = {}
	self:_build()
	self:Randomize()
	return self
end

function GlassBridge:_build()
	local old = self.Folder:FindFirstChild("Generated")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local generated = Instance.new("Folder")
	generated.Name = "Generated"
	generated.Parent = self.Folder

	local startPos = self.StartMarker.Position
	local endPos = self.EndMarker.Position
	local flat = Vector3.new(endPos.X - startPos.X, 0, endPos.Z - startPos.Z)
	local length = flat.Magnitude
	local base = CFrame.lookAt(startPos, startPos + flat.Unit)

	local rows = math.max(1, Config.GlassRows)
	local step = length / rows
	local size = Config.GlassSize
	local side = Config.GlassSideOffset

	-- cadre décoratif (2 poutres par côté + traverses)
	local beamSize = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, length)
	for _, x in { -side - size.X / 2 - 0.4, side + size.X / 2 + 0.4, 0 } do
		local beam = makePart("Beam", beamSize, base * CFrame.new(x, -0.6, -length / 2), generated)
		beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
		beam.Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate
		beam.CanCollide = false -- sinon on traverse en marchant sur le cadre
		beam.CanTouch = false
	end

	for row = 1, rows do
		local z = -(row - 0.5) * step
		for _, dir in { -1, 1 } do
			local panel = makePart("Glass", size, base * CFrame.new(dir * side, 0, z), generated)
			panel.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
			panel.Color = Config.GlassColor
			panel.Transparency = Config.GlassTransparency
			panel:SetAttribute("Row", row)

			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = "BreakSound"
			sound.SoundId = Config.GlassBreakSound
			sound.Volume = 0.8
			sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
			sound.Parent = panel

			local attach = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attach.Parent = panel
			local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			emitter.Name = "Shards"
			emitter.Enabled = false
			emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.GlassColor)
			emitter.LightEmission = 0.4
			emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 0.1)
			emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
			emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
			emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20)
			emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
			emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
			emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200)
			emitter.Parent = attach

			panel.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				self:_onTouched(panel, hit)
			end)
			table.insert(self.Panels, panel)
		end
	end
end

function GlassBridge:_onTouched(panel, hit)
	if not self.Fragile[panel] or self.Broken[panel] then
		return
	end
	if not getCharacterFromPart(hit) then
		return
	end
	self.Broken[panel] = true
	panel.CanCollide = false
	panel.CanTouch = false
	panel.Transparency = 1
	playBreakEffect(panel)
end

-- Nouveau motif aléatoire + toutes les vitres réparées.
function GlassBridge:Randomize()
	table.clear(self.Fragile)
	table.clear(self.Broken)
	for i = 1, #self.Panels, 2 do
		local left, right = self.Panels[i], self.Panels[i + 1]
		if rng:NextInteger(0, 1) == 0 then
			self.Fragile[left] = true
		else
			self.Fragile[right] = true
		end
		for _, panel in { left, right } do
			panel.CanCollide = true
			panel.CanTouch = true
			panel.Transparency = Config.GlassTransparency
		end
	end
end

return GlassBridge

-- Démarre le kit Obby / Glass Bridge (voir README)
require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ObbyService")).Start()

-- ObbyService : logique serveur du kit (checkpoints, kill bricks, victoire,
-- manches, pont de verre, Skip stage, sauvegarde des Wins).
-- Tout est décidé ici ; le client ne fait qu'afficher.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local KitShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KIT_Obby")
local Config = require(KitShared:WaitForChild("ObbyConfig"))
local WinsStore = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WinsStore"))
local GlassBridge = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("GlassBridge"))

local ObbyService = {}

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("KIT_Obby"):WaitForChild("ObbyMap")
local startPart = map:WaitForChild("Start")
local winPad = map:WaitForChild("WinPad")

local checkpoints = {} -- [stage] = part (0 = départ)
local finalStage = 0

local stageOf = {}     -- [player] = stage atteint
local winsOf = {}      -- [player] = wins (source de vérité, pas les leaderstats)
local runStart = {}    -- [player] = os.clock() au départ du parcours
local lastWin = {}     -- [player] = os.clock() de la dernière victoire
local processedPurchases = {} -- [PurchaseId] = true

local bridge
local notify -- RemoteEvent serveur -> client

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilitaires

local function playerFromHit(hit)
	local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model), humanoid
end

local function setStage(player, stage)
	stageOf[player] = stage
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Stage") then
		ls.Stage.Value = stage
	end
end

local function setWins(player, wins)
	winsOf[player] = wins
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Wins") then
		ls.Wins.Value = wins
	end
end

local function teleportTo(player, part)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return
	end
	local _, yaw = part.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local pos = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 3.5, 0)
	character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0))
end

local function sendToStart(player)
	setStage(player, 0)
	runStart[player] = os.clock()
	teleportTo(player, startPart)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- joueurs

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	task.wait() -- laisse le spawn par défaut se faire, puis on repositionne
	local stage = stageOf[player] or 0
	if stage == 0 then
		runStart[player] = os.clock()
	end
	teleportTo(player, checkpoints[stage] or startPart)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	local wins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	wins.Name = "Wins"
	wins.Parent = ls
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Parent = ls
	ls.Parent = player

	stageOf[player] = 0
	runStart[player] = os.clock()
	setWins(player, WinsStore.Load(player))

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacterAdded, player, player.Character)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	WinsStore.Save(player, winsOf[player] or 0)
	WinsStore.Forget(player)
	stageOf[player] = nil
	winsOf[player] = nil
	runStart[player] = nil
	lastWin[player] = nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- parcours

local function onCheckpointTouched(part, hit)
	local player = playerFromHit(hit)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local stage = part:GetAttribute("Stage")
	local current = stageOf[player] or 0
	-- uniquement le checkpoint suivant : impossible de sauter des étapes
	if stage ~= current + 1 then
		return
	end
	setStage(player, stage)
	notify:FireClient(player, "Checkpoint", stage, finalStage)
end

local function onWinPadTouched(hit)
	local player = playerFromHit(hit)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	if (stageOf[player] or 0) < finalStage then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastWin[player] and now - lastWin[player] < Config.WinCooldown then
		return
	end
	lastWin[player] = now

	local newWins = (winsOf[player] or 0) + Config.WinsPerVictory
	setWins(player, newWins)
	WinsStore.MarkDirty(player)

	local runTime = now - (runStart[player] or now)
	notify:FireClient(player, "Win", newWins, runTime)
	task.delay(1, function()
		if player.Parent then
			sendToStart(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function onKillTouched(hit)
	local player, humanoid = playerFromHit(hit)
	if player and humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- manches

local function roundLoop()
	local round = 0
	while true do
		round += 1
		KitShared:SetAttribute("Round", round)
		KitShared:SetAttribute("RoundEndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + Config.RoundDuration)
		task.wait(Config.RoundDuration)

		bridge:Randomize()
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if Config.ResetPlayersOnNewRound then
				sendToStart(player)
			end
			notify:FireClient(player, "NewRound", round + 1)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Skip stage (Developer Product)

function ObbyService.HandleReceipt(receiptInfo)
	if receiptInfo.ProductId ~= Config.SkipStageProductId or Config.SkipStageProductId == 0 then
		return nil -- pas pour ce kit
	end
	if processedPurchases[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player or not stageOf[player] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- re-tenté au retour du joueur
	end

	local stage = stageOf[player]
	if stage < finalStage then
		setStage(player, stage + 1)
		teleportTo(player, checkpoints[stage + 1])
		notify:FireClient(player, "Checkpoint", stage + 1, finalStage)
	else
		teleportTo(player, winPad) -- déjà au dernier checkpoint : direction la victoire
	end
	processedPurchases[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ObbyService.Start()
	-- remotes (créés par le serveur uniquement)
	local remotes = KitShared:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "Remotes"
	remotes.Parent = KitShared
	notify = remotes:FindFirstChild("ObbyNotify") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	notify.Name = "ObbyNotify"
	notify.Parent = remotes

	-- checkpoints
	checkpoints[0] = startPart
	for _, cp in map:WaitForChild("Checkpoints"):GetChildren() do
		local stage = cp:GetAttribute("Stage")
		if cp:IsA("BasePart") and type(stage) == "number" then
			checkpoints[stage] = cp
			finalStage = math.max(finalStage, stage)
			cp.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				onCheckpointTouched(cp, hit)
			end)
		end
	end
	KitShared:SetAttribute("FinalStage", finalStage)

	for _, part in map:WaitForChild("KillBricks"):GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(onKillTouched)
		end
	end
	winPad.Touched:Connect(onWinPadTouched)

	bridge = GlassBridge.new(map:WaitForChild("GlassBridge"))

	if Config.OwnProcessReceipt and Config.SkipStageProductId ~= 0 then
		MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
			return ObbyService.HandleReceipt(receiptInfo) or Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end

	task.spawn(roundLoop)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.AutoSaveInterval)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				task.spawn(WinsStore.Save, player, winsOf[player] or 0)
			end
		end
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				WinsStore.Save(player, winsOf[player] or 0)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local t = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - t < 25 do
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)
end

return ObbyService

--[[
==========================================================================
 KIT OBBY / GLASS BRIDGE  –  README  (script désactivé, ne pas activer)
==========================================================================

CE QUE FAIT LE KIT
  • Pont de verre généré par script : N rangées de 2 vitres identiques,
    une solide et une qui casse (son + particules + éclats). Le motif est
    tiré au hasard côté serveur à chaque manche et n'est JAMAIS répliqué
    (un exploiteur ne peut pas lire quelle vitre est solide).
  • Checkpoints dans l'ordre (impossible de sauter une étape), kill bricks,
    plateforme de victoire qui donne des Wins et renvoie au départ.
  • Timer de manche (UI) + écran de victoire (WinGui issue de GlassBridge).
  • Developer Product « Skip stage » sécurisé via ProcessReceipt.
  • Sauvegarde des Wins (DataStore, pcall + retry, autosave, BindToClose).

OÙ PLACER CHAQUE DOSSIER (dans le Model ObbyBridgeKit)
  Workspace/KIT_Obby            -> Workspace
  ReplicatedStorage/KIT_Obby    -> ReplicatedStorage   (ObbyConfig)

CONFIGURATION  (ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Obby.ObbyConfig)

-- WinsStore : charge / sauvegarde les Wins des joueurs (DataStore + pcall + retry).
-- Si le chargement échoue, on ne sauvegarde PAS ce joueur (évite d'écraser ses données).

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("KIT_Obby"):WaitForChild("ObbyConfig"))

local MAX_TRIES = 4

local WinsStore = {}

local store = nil
local okStore, err = pcall(function()
	store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
end)
if not okStore then
	warn("[KIT_Obby] DataStore indisponible (" .. tostring(err) .. ") : les Wins ne seront pas sauvegardés.")
end

local loaded = {} -- [userId] = true si la donnée a bien été chargée
local dirty = {}  -- [userId] = true si à sauvegarder

local function retry(fn)
	local lastErr
	for attempt = 1, MAX_TRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastErr = result
		task.wait(2 ^ (attempt - 1)) -- 1, 2, 4, 8 s
	end
	return false, lastErr
end

-- Retourne le nombre de Wins (0 si nouveau joueur ou erreur).
function WinsStore.Load(player)
	if not store then
		return 0
	end
	local key = "u_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[KIT_Obby] Chargement impossible pour " .. player.Name .. " : " .. tostring(data))
		return 0
	end
	loaded[player.UserId] = true
	if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Wins) == "number" then
		return math.max(0, math.floor(data.Wins))
	end
	return 0
end

function WinsStore.MarkDirty(player)
	dirty[player.UserId] = true
end

function WinsStore.Save(player, wins)
	local userId = player.UserId
	if not store or not loaded[userId] or not dirty[userId] then
		return
	end
	local ok, saveErr = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("u_" .. userId, function(old)
			old = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			old.Wins = wins
			old.Version = 1
			return old
		end)
	end)
	if ok then
		dirty[userId] = nil
	else
		warn("[KIT_Obby] Sauvegarde ratée pour " .. player.Name .. " : " .. tostring(saveErr))
	end
end

function WinsStore.Forget(player)
	loaded[player.UserId] = nil
	dirty[player.UserId] = nil
end

return WinsStore

-- ObbyClient : affichage uniquement (timer de manche, étape, victoire, bouton Skip).
-- Aucune décision ici : le serveur valide tout.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local KitShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KIT_Obby")
local Config = require(KitShared:WaitForChild("ObbyConfig"))
local notify = KitShared:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("ObbyNotify")

local hud = script.Parent
local topBar = hud:WaitForChild("TopBar")
local timerLabel = topBar:WaitForChild("TimerLabel")
local stageLabel = topBar:WaitForChild("StageLabel")
local skipButton = hud:WaitForChild("SkipButton")
local toast = hud:WaitForChild("Toast")

local winGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("KIT_Obby_WinGui")
local winPanel = winGui:WaitForChild("Frame"):WaitForChild("Panel")
local winTime = winPanel:WaitForChild("TimeLabel")
local winCount = winPanel:WaitForChild("WinsLabel")
local continueButton = winPanel:WaitForChild("ContinueHolder"):WaitForChild("ContinueButton")

local function showToast(text, color)
	toast.Text = text
	toast.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	toast.Visible = true
	toast.TextTransparency = 0
	toast:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0
	task.delay(1.6, function()
		if toast.Text == text then
			toast.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

local function updateStage(stage)
	local final = KitShared:GetAttribute("FinalStage") or 0
	stageLabel.Text = "Étape " .. stage .. " / " .. final
end

-- Skip stage --------------------------------------------------------------
skipButton.Visible = Config.SkipStageProductId ~= 0
skipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if Config.SkipStageProductId ~= 0 then
		MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, Config.SkipStageProductId)
	end
end)

-- Victoire ----------------------------------------------------------------
winGui.Enabled = false
local panelSize = winPanel.Size

continueButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	winGui.Enabled = false
end)

local function showWin(wins, runTime)
	winTime.Text = string.format("Temps : %.1f s", runTime)
	winCount.Text = "Wins : " .. wins
	winPanel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	winGui.Enabled = true
	TweenService:Create(winPanel, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = panelSize }):Play()
	task.delay(4, function()
		winGui.Enabled = false
	end)
end

notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, a, b)
	if kind == "Checkpoint" then
		updateStage(a)
		showToast("Checkpoint " .. a .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140))
	elseif kind == "Win" then
		updateStage(0)
		showWin(a, b)
	elseif kind == "NewRound" then
		showToast("Nouvelle manche : le verre a changé !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
	end
end)

-- l'étape réelle vient des leaderstats (écrits par le serveur)
task.spawn(function()
	local stageValue = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Stage")
	updateStage(stageValue.Value)
	stageValue.Changed:Connect(updateStage)
end)

-- Timer de manche ---------------------------------------------------------
while true do
	local endsAt = KitShared:GetAttribute("RoundEndsAt")
	if endsAt then
		local left = math.max(0, math.floor(endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
		timerLabel.Text = string.format("Manche %d  •  %d:%02d", KitShared:GetAttribute("Round") or 1, left // 60, left % 60)
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
end

# ObbyBridgeKit – Obby / Glass Bridge

Kit Roblox prêt à l'emploi : pont de verre (une vitre solide, une qui casse), checkpoints, kill bricks, plateforme de victoire avec Wins sauvegardés, timer de manche, écran de victoire et Developer Product « Skip stage ».
Inspiré de GlassBridge / CashgrabBridgeEU, code réécrit de zéro (aucun script d'origine).

## Installation
Insère `ObbyBridgeKit.rbxm` dans Studio, puis déplace chaque dossier dans son service :

| Dans le Model | Va dans |
|---|---|
| `Workspace/KIT_Obby` | Workspace (contient `ObbyMap`) |
| `ReplicatedStorage/KIT_Obby` | ReplicatedStorage (`ObbyConfig`) |
| `ServerScriptService/KIT_Obby` | ServerScriptService (`ObbyServer`, `ObbyService`, `GlassBridge`, `WinsStore`, `README`) |
| `StarterGui/KIT_Obby_HUD` + `KIT_Obby_WinGui` | StarterGui |

Ne renomme pas les dossiers `KIT_Obby` (les scripts les cherchent par nom). Supprime ensuite le Model vide.

## Configuration (`ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Obby.ObbyConfig`)
- `GlassRows` : nombre de rangées. L'espacement s'adapte entre les repères `GlassStart` et `GlassEnd`.
- `GlassSize`, `GlassSideOffset`, `GlassColor`, `GlassTransparency`, `GlassBreakSound`.
- `RoundDuration` : durée d'une manche (s). À chaque nouvelle manche, nouveau motif de verre.
- `ResetPlayersOnNewRound` : renvoie tout le monde au départ à chaque manche.
- `WinsPerVictory`, `WinCooldown`.
- `SkipStageProductId` : ID du Developer Product (0 = bouton caché).
- `OwnProcessReceipt` : `true` = le kit définit `MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt`. Si ton jeu en a déjà un (un seul autorisé par jeu), mets `false` et appelle `ObbyService.HandleReceipt(receiptInfo)` depuis ton handler (il renvoie `nil` si l'achat ne concerne pas le kit).
- `DataStoreName`, `AutoSaveInterval`.

Pour tester la sauvegarde dans Studio : Game Settings > Security > *Enable Studio Access to API Services*.

## Modifier le parcours (`Workspace.KIT_Obby.ObbyMap`)
- `Start` : départ (étape 0, respawn).
- `Checkpoints/` : Parts avec l'attribut `Stage` = 1, 2, 3… dans l'ordre. Le plus grand = étape requise pour gagner.
- `KillBricks/` : toute Part ici tue au contact.
- `GlassBridge/GlassStart` et `GlassEnd` : repères invisibles du pont (les vitres sont générées au lancement dans `GlassBridge/Generated`).
- `Obstacles/` : plateformes de saut.
- `WinPad` : plateforme de victoire (+Wins puis retour au départ).

## Sécurité
- Le motif du verre n'existe que dans une table serveur : rien de répliqué (attribut, propriété) ne révèle la bonne vitre.
- Le client n'envoie aucun remote : il reçoit seulement `ObbyNotify` (checkpoint, victoire, nouvelle manche).
- Checkpoints validés dans l'ordre (impossible d'en sauter), victoire seulement si le dernier checkpoint est atteint, cooldown anti double-gain.
- Wins gardés dans une table serveur ; les leaderstats ne servent qu'à l'affichage.
- DataStore : `UpdateAsync` + retry exponentiel, autosave, `BindToClose`. Un joueur dont le chargement a échoué n'est pas sauvegardé (pas d'écrasement).
- ProcessReceipt : idempotent par `PurchaseId`, `NotProcessedYet` si le joueur n'est plus là.

function Config.GetMultiplier(rebirths, equippedPetNames)

--[[
	KIT_Simulator - PlayerData
	Chargement / sauvegarde des joueurs.
	- UpdateAsync uniquement (pas de SetAsync)
	- pcall + retry avec backoff
	- verrou de session (un seul serveur possède les données d'un joueur)
	- autosave + sauvegarde au départ + BindToClose
	- si le chargement échoue en jeu publié : kick (on n'écrase jamais une vraie sauvegarde)
]]

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Simulator.Config)

local PlayerData = {}

local LOCK_STALE_TIME = Config.AutosaveInterval * 3
local store = nil
local profiles = {} -- [player] = { Data = table, CanSave = bool }
local onLoadedCallbacks = {}

local function getStore()
	if store == nil then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
		end)
		store = ok and result or false
	end
	return store or nil
end

local function defaultData()
	return {
		Version = Config.DataVersion,
		Cash = 0,
		Strength = 0,
		Rebirths = 0,
		Pets = {}, -- { { Id = "1", Name = "Bear" }, ... }
		Equipped = {}, -- { "1", ... } (Id des pets)
		NextPetId = 1,
	}
end

-- Nettoie des données chargées (types, pets inconnus, etc.)
local function sanitize(data)
	local clean = defaultData()
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return clean
	end
	local function num(v)
		if type(v) == "number" and v == v and v >= 0 and v < math.huge then
			return v
		end
		return 0
	end
	clean.Cash = num(data.Cash)
	clean.Strength = num(data.Strength)
	clean.Rebirths = math.floor(num(data.Rebirths))
	clean.NextPetId = math.max(1, math.floor(num(data.NextPetId)))

	local ids = {}
	if type(data.Pets) == "table" then
		for _, pet in data.Pets do
			if type(pet) == "table" and type(pet.Id) == "string" and Config.Pets[pet.Name] and not ids[pet.Id] then
				if #clean.Pets < Config.MaxPets then
					table.insert(clean.Pets, { Id = pet.Id, Name = pet.Name })
					ids[pet.Id] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if type(data.Equipped) == "table" then
		for _, id in data.Equipped do
			if ids[id] and #clean.Equipped < Config.MaxEquipped and not table.find(clean.Equipped, id) then
				table.insert(clean.Equipped, id)
			end
		end
	end
	return clean
end

local function isFatalError(message)
	message = tostring(message)
	return string.find(message, "403") ~= nil or string.find(message, "not allowed") ~= nil
end

local function withRetry(fn)
	local delaySeconds = 1
	for attempt = 1, 4 do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("[KIT_Simulator] DataStore essai %d/4 échoué : %s"):format(attempt, tostring(result)))
		if isFatalError(result) or attempt == 4 then
			return false, result
		end
		task.wait(delaySeconds)
		delaySeconds = math.min(delaySeconds * 2, 8)
	end
	return false, "unreachable"
end

-- Charge + prend le verrou de session. Retourne (data, raison_erreur)
local function loadAndLock(userId)
	local ds = getStore()
	if not ds then
		return nil, "DataStore indisponible"
	end
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local lockedByOther = false
		local loaded = nil
		local ok, err = withRetry(function()
			return ds:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(old)
				lockedByOther = false
				if type(old) == "table" and type(old.Lock) == "table" then
					local lock = old.Lock
					if lock.JobId ~= game.JobId and os.time() - (tonumber(lock.Time) or 0) < LOCK_STALE_TIME then
						lockedByOther = true
						return nil -- annule l'écriture
					end
				end
				local data = sanitize(old)
				data.Lock = { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() }
				loaded = data
				return data
			end)
		end)
		if not ok then
			return nil, err
		end
		if not lockedByOther and loaded then
			loaded.Lock = nil
			return loaded
		end
		task.wait(3) -- un autre serveur est peut-être en train de sauvegarder
	end
	return nil, "Données encore verrouillées par un autre serveur"
end

local function save(player, release)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile or not profile.CanSave then
		return
	end
	local ds = getStore()
	if not ds then
		return
	end
	local snapshot = table.clone(profile.Data)
	snapshot.Pets = table.clone(profile.Data.Pets)
	snapshot.Equipped = table.clone(profile.Data.Equipped)
	snapshot.Lock = (not release) and { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() } or nil

	local ok, err = withRetry(function()
		return ds:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
			if type(old) == "table" and type(old.Lock) == "table" and old.Lock.JobId ~= game.JobId then
				return nil -- un autre serveur a pris la main : on n'écrase pas
			end
			return snapshot
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[KIT_Simulator] Sauvegarde impossible pour " .. player.Name .. " : " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

function PlayerData.Get(player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return profile and profile.Data or nil
end

function PlayerData.OnLoaded(callback)
	table.insert(onLoadedCallbacks, callback)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local data, err = loadAndLock(player.UserId)
	local canSave = true
	if not data then
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			warn("[KIT_Simulator] Studio : DataStore non disponible (" .. tostring(err) .. "). "
				.. "Partie sans sauvegarde. Active 'Enable Studio Access to API Services' pour tester la sauvegarde.")
			data = defaultData()
			canSave = false
		else
			player:Kick("Impossible de charger tes données, reconnecte-toi dans un instant.")
			return
		end
	end
	profiles[player] = { Data = data, CanSave = canSave }
	if not player.Parent then
		-- le joueur est parti pendant le chargement : on relâche le verrou
		save(player, true)
		profiles[player] = nil
		return
	end
	for _, callback in onLoadedCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, player, data)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	if profiles[player] then
		save(player, true)
		profiles[player] = nil
	end
end

function PlayerData.Start()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end

	-- Autosave
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.AutosaveInterval)
			for player in profiles do
				task.spawn(save, player, false)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Fermeture du serveur : on sauvegarde tout le monde en parallèle
	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player in profiles do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				save(player, true)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local start = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - start < 25 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

return PlayerData

--[[
=====================================================================
  KIT SIMULATOR  -  README (script désactivé, ne s'exécute pas)
=====================================================================

CE QUE FAIT LE KIT
  - Entraînement : bouton "ENTRAÎNER" (ou touche E) -> gagne de la Force.
  - SellPad (dalle verte "VENDRE") : marcher dessus convertit la Force en Cash.
  - Œuf : approche-toi de l'œuf et maintiens F (ProximityPrompt) pour l'ouvrir.
    Il coûte du Cash et donne un pet aléatoire (Commun / Rare / Épique / Légendaire).
  - Pets : ils suivent le joueur, chaque pet équipé ajoute un bonus au multiplicateur.
    Bouton "Pets" à gauche -> inventaire : Équiper / Retirer.
  - Rebirth : bouton "Rebirth" -> remet Cash et Force à 0 contre un multiplicateur permanent.
  - Sauvegarde DataStore : Cash, Force, Rebirths, pets, pets équipés.

OÙ PLACER CHAQUE DOSSIER (dans le Model "SimulatorKit")
  Workspace/KIT_Simulator            -> Workspace            (SellPad + EggStand, déplace-les où tu veux)
  ServerScriptService/KIT_Simulator  -> ServerScriptService  (Main, SimulatorServer, PlayerData)
  ReplicatedStorage/KIT_Simulator    -> ReplicatedStorage    (Config, Assets/Pets, Assets/Egg)
  StarterGui/KIT_SimulatorHUD        -> StarterGui           (l'interface)
  StarterPlayerScripts/KIT_Simulator -> StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts (HUDController, PetFollow)
  Garde les NOMS des dossiers : les scripts les cherchent par leur nom.

CONFIGURATION (ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Simulator.Config)
  - StrengthPerClick, ClickCooldown        : gain et vitesse d'entraînement
  - CashPerStrength                        : taux de vente
  - Egg.Price, Egg.Chances                 : prix de l'œuf et poids des raretés
  - Pets                                   : liste des pets (Rarity + Bonus)
  - MaxEquipped, MaxPets                   : limites d'inventaire
  - Rebirth.BaseCost / CostGrowth / BonusPerRebirth
  - DataStoreName                          : change-le pour repartir de zéro
  Pas de gamepass ni de produit Robux dans ce kit (aucun ID à remplir).

AJOUTER UN PET
  1. Mets un Model (avec PrimaryPart) dans ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Simulator.Assets.Pets
  2. Ajoute une ligne dans Config.Pets avec EXACTEMENT le même nom.

SÉCURITÉ
  - Tout est calculé sur le serveur (SimulatorServer). Le client ne fait que demander.
  - Chaque RemoteEvent vérifie le type des arguments + anti-spam (cooldown par joueur).
  - La vente passe par le Touched du SellPad côté serveur, l'œuf par le ProximityPrompt côté serveur.

SAUVEGARDE
  - UpdateAsync + pcall + retry (backoff), verrou de session, autosave, BindToClose.
  - En Studio : active Game Settings > Security > "Enable Studio Access to API Services"
    pour tester la sauvegarde. Sinon le jeu marche mais ne sauvegarde pas (message dans la console).
  - En jeu publié, si le chargement échoue, le joueur est kick (pour ne jamais écraser sa sauvegarde).

ORIGINE DES ASSETS
  Modèles de pets et d'œuf : Tapping Lords Simulator (nettoyés, sans scripts).
  Icônes de boutons : UIMegaPack. Code : neuf, écrit pour ce kit.
]]

--[[
	KIT_Simulator - SimulatorServer
	Toute la logique du jeu, côté serveur uniquement :
	entraînement, vente, œufs, pets, rebirth.
	Le client ne fait que DEMANDER (RemoteEvents) ; ici on vérifie tout.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Simulator
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local PlayerData = require(script.Parent.PlayerData)

local World = workspace:WaitForChild("KIT_Simulator")
local PetModels = Shared.Assets.Pets

local Server = {}

local remotes = {}
local lastAction = {} -- [player][action] = os.clock()
local random = Random.new()

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utilitaires
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function getRemote(name)
	local folder = Shared:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Remotes"
		folder.Parent = Shared
	end
	local remote = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not remote then
		remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = folder
	end
	remotes[name] = remote
	return remote
end

-- Anti-spam : refuse une action si elle arrive trop vite
local function canAct(player, action, cooldown)
	local now = os.clock()
	local times = lastAction[player]
	if not times then
		times = {}
		lastAction[player] = times
	end
	if times[action] and now - times[action] < cooldown then
		return false
	end
	times[action] = now
	return true
end

local function notify(player, message)
	remotes.Notify:FireClient(player, message)
end

local function getEquippedNames(data)
	local names = {}
	for _, id in data.Equipped do
		for _, pet in data.Pets do
			if pet.Id == id then
				table.insert(names, pet.Name)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return names
end

local function getMultiplier(data)
	return Config.GetMultiplier(data.Rebirths, getEquippedNames(data))
end

-- Met à jour les leaderstats (simple miroir, jamais relu comme source de vérité)
local function refreshStats(player)
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not data or not stats then
		return
	end
	stats.Force.Value = data.Strength
	stats.Cash.Value = data.Cash
	stats.Rebirths.Value = data.Rebirths
	player:SetAttribute("KIT_Multiplier", getMultiplier(data))
end

local function syncPets(player)
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if data then
		remotes.PetsSync:FireClient(player, data.Pets, data.Equipped)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pets qui suivent (le serveur crée les modèles, les clients les animent)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function getActivePetsFolder()
	local folder = World:FindFirstChild("ActivePets")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "ActivePets"
		folder.Parent = World
	end
	return folder
end

local function clearPetModels(player)
	for _, model in getActivePetsFolder():GetChildren() do
		if model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			model:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function spawnPetModels(player)
	clearPetModels(player)
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not data or not root then
		return
	end
	for slot, name in getEquippedNames(data) do
		local template = PetModels:FindFirstChild(name)
		if template then
			local model = template:Clone()
			model.Name = player.Name .. "_" .. name
			model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
			model:SetAttribute("Slot", slot)
			for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.Anchored = true
					part.CanCollide = false
					part.CanTouch = false
					part.CanQuery = false
				end
			end
			model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(slot * 3 - 6, 0, 5))
			model.Parent = getActivePetsFolder()
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Actions (appelées par les remotes, le SellPad et le ProximityPrompt)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Server.Train(player)
	if not canAct(player, "Train", Config.ClickCooldown) then
		return false
	end
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	data.Strength += Config.StrengthPerClick * getMultiplier(data)
	refreshStats(player)
	return true
end

function Server.Sell(player)
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not data or data.Strength <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if not canAct(player, "Sell", Config.SellCooldown) then
		return false
	end
	local gained = math.floor(data.Strength * Config.CashPerStrength)
	data.Cash += gained
	data.Strength = 0
	refreshStats(player)
	notify(player, "+" .. gained .. " Cash")
	return true
end

local function rollPet()
	local total = 0
	for _, weight in Config.Egg.Chances do
		total += weight
	end
	local roll = random:NextNumber(0, total)
	local rarity = nil
	for name, weight in Config.Egg.Chances do
		roll -= weight
		rarity = name
		if roll <= 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	local pool = {}
	for petName, info in Config.Pets do
		if info.Rarity == rarity then
			table.insert(pool, petName)
		end
	end
	if #pool == 0 then
		for petName in Config.Pets do
			table.insert(pool, petName)
		end
	end
	table.sort(pool)
	return pool[random:NextInteger(1, #pool)]
end

function Server.Hatch(player)
	if not canAct(player, "Hatch", Config.Egg.Cooldown) then
		return nil
	end
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not data then
		return nil
	end
	if #data.Pets >= Config.MaxPets then
		notify(player, "Inventaire plein (" .. Config.MaxPets .. " pets max)")
		return nil
	end
	if data.Cash < Config.Egg.Price then
		notify(player, "Pas assez de Cash (" .. Config.Egg.Price .. " requis)")
		return nil
	end
	data.Cash -= Config.Egg.Price
	local petName = rollPet()
	local pet = { Id = tostring(data.NextPetId), Name = petName }
	data.NextPetId += 1
	table.insert(data.Pets, pet)
	-- équipe automatiquement si une place est libre
	if #data.Equipped < Config.MaxEquipped then
		table.insert(data.Equipped, pet.Id)
		spawnPetModels(player)
	end
	refreshStats(player)
	syncPets(player)
	remotes.HatchResult:FireClient(player, petName)
	return pet
end

local function findPet(data, petId)
	for _, pet in data.Pets do
		if pet.Id == petId then
			return pet
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Server.Equip(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or #petId > 20 then
		return false
	end
	if not canAct(player, "Pet", Config.PetActionCooldown) then
		return false
	end
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not data or not findPet(data, petId) or table.find(data.Equipped, petId) then
		return false
	end
	if #data.Equipped >= Config.MaxEquipped then
		notify(player, "Maximum " .. Config.MaxEquipped .. " pets équipés")
		return false
	end
	table.insert(data.Equipped, petId)
	spawnPetModels(player)
	refreshStats(player)
	syncPets(player)
	return true
end

function Server.Unequip(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or #petId > 20 then
		return false
	end
	if not canAct(player, "Pet", Config.PetActionCooldown) then
		return false
	end
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	local index = data and table.find(data.Equipped, petId)
	if not index then
		return false
	end
	table.remove(data.Equipped, index)
	spawnPetModels(player)
	refreshStats(player)
	syncPets(player)
	return true
end

function Server.Rebirth(player)
	if not canAct(player, "Rebirth", Config.Rebirth.Cooldown) then
		return false
	end
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	local cost = Config.GetRebirthCost(data.Rebirths)
	if data.Cash < cost then
		notify(player, "Il te faut " .. cost .. " Cash pour renaître")
		return false
	end
	data.Rebirths += 1
	data.Cash = 0
	data.Strength = 0
	refreshStats(player)
	notify(player, "Rebirth ! Multiplicateur x" .. string.format("%.2f", getMultiplier(data)))
	return true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Démarrage
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function onPlayerLoaded(player, _data)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	for _, statName in { "Force", "Cash", "Rebirths" } do
		local value = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		value.Name = statName
		value.Parent = stats
	end
	stats.Parent = player
	refreshStats(player)
	syncPets(player)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5)
		spawnPetModels(player)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		spawnPetModels(player)
	end
end

local function setupSellPad()
	local pad = World:FindFirstChild("SellPad")
	if not pad then
		warn("[KIT_Simulator] Workspace.KIT_Simulator.SellPad introuvable")
		return
	end
	pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			Server.Sell(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function setupEgg()
	local stand = World:FindFirstChild("EggStand")
	local prompt = stand and stand:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	if not prompt then
		warn("[KIT_Simulator] ProximityPrompt de l'EggStand introuvable")
		return
	end
	prompt.ActionText = "Ouvrir (" .. Config.Egg.Price .. " Cash)"
	prompt.ObjectText = Config.Egg.DisplayName
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		Server.Hatch(player)
	end)
end

function Server.Start()
	for _, name in { "Train", "EquipPet", "UnequipPet", "Rebirth", "PetsSync", "HatchResult", "Notify", "RequestSync" } do
		getRemote(name)
	end

	remotes.Train.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		Server.Train(player)
	end)
	remotes.EquipPet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId)
		Server.Equip(player, petId)
	end)
	remotes.UnequipPet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId)
		Server.Unequip(player, petId)
	end)
	remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		Server.Rebirth(player)
	end)
	remotes.RequestSync.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		if canAct(player, "Sync", 1) then
			syncPets(player)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAction[player] = nil
		clearPetModels(player)
	end)

	getActivePetsFolder()
	setupSellPad()
	setupEgg()
	PlayerData.OnLoaded(onPlayerLoaded)
	PlayerData.Start()
end

-- Accès en lecture pour les tests / autres systèmes
Server.GetData = PlayerData.Get
Server.GetMultiplier = function(player)
	local data = PlayerData.Get(player)
	return data and getMultiplier(data) or 1
end

return Server

	KIT_Simulator - HUDController (LocalScript)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KIT_Simulator")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))

local PetModels = Shared:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Pets")

-- Les boutons UIMegaPack peuvent être un ImageButton ou contenir un bouton
local function getButton(object)
	if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
		return object
	end
	return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)
end

local function formatNumber(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	local suffixes = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
	local i = 1
	local value = n
	while value >= 1000 and i < #suffixes do
		value /= 1000
		i += 1
	end
	if i == 1 then
		return tostring(n)
	end
	return string.format("%.1f%s", value, suffixes[i])
end

local function pop(object)
	local scale = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", object)
	scale.Scale = 0.85
	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
end

-- Stats

local function refreshStats()
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")

	stats.Force.Value.Text = formatNumber(leaderstats.Force.Value)
	stats.Cash.Value.Text = formatNumber(leaderstats.Cash.Value)
	stats.Rebirths.Value.Text = formatNumber(leaderstats.Rebirths.Value)
	stats.Multiplier.Value.Text = "x" .. string.format("%.2f", player:GetAttribute("KIT_Multiplier") or 1)

	local rebirths = leaderstats.Rebirths.Value
	rebirthPanel.Info.Text = ("Coût : %s Cash\nBonus actuel : x%.2f\nAprès rebirth : x%.2f (Cash et Force remis à 0)"):format(
		formatNumber(Config.GetRebirthCost(rebirths)),
		1 + rebirths * Config.Rebirth.BonusPerRebirth,
		1 + (rebirths + 1) * Config.Rebirth.BonusPerRebirth
	)
end

local function watchLeaderstats(leaderstats)
	for _, value in leaderstats:GetChildren() do
		value.Changed:Connect(refreshStats)
	end
	refreshStats()
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("KIT_Multiplier"):Connect(refreshStats)
task.spawn(function()

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Inventaire de pets
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function setViewport(viewport, petName)
	viewport:ClearAllChildren()
	local template = PetModels:FindFirstChild(petName)
	if not template then
		return
	end
	local model = template:Clone()
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	model.Parent = viewport
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	local size = model:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size * 0.15, -size * 1.1), Vector3.zero)
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
end

local function rarityOrder(petName)
	local info = Config.Pets[petName]
	return info and Config.Rarities[info.Rarity].Order or 0
end

local function renderPets()
	for _, child in petList:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= petTemplate then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local sorted = table.clone(currentPets)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		local ea = table.find(currentEquipped, a.Id) ~= nil
		local eb = table.find(currentEquipped, b.Id) ~= nil
		if ea ~= eb then
			return ea
		end
		if rarityOrder(a.Name) ~= rarityOrder(b.Name) then
			return rarityOrder(a.Name) > rarityOrder(b.Name)
		end
		return tonumber(a.Id) < tonumber(b.Id)
	end)

	for index, pet in sorted do
		local info = Config.Pets[pet.Name]
		local rarity = Config.Rarities[info.Rarity]
		local equipped = table.find(currentEquipped, pet.Id) ~= nil
		local card = petTemplate:Clone()
		card.Name = "Pet_" .. pet.Id
		card.LayoutOrder = index
		card.Visible = true
		card.PetName.Text = pet.Name
		card.Rarity.Text = rarity.Label .. "  +" .. math.floor(info.Bonus * 100) .. "%"
		card.Rarity.TextColor3 = rarity.Color
		card.UIStroke.Color = equipped and Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 120) or rarity.Color
		card.Equip.Text = equipped and "Retirer" or "Équiper"
		card.Equip.BackgroundColor3 = equipped and Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 100)
		setViewport(card.Viewport, pet.Name)
		card.Equip.Activated:Connect(function()
			if equipped then
				Remotes.UnequipPet:FireServer(pet.Id)
			else
				Remotes.EquipPet:FireServer(pet.Id)
			end
		end)
		card.Parent = petList
	end
	petsPanel.Count.Text = ("%d/%d pets  -  %d/%d équipés"):format(#currentPets, Config.MaxPets, #currentEquipped, Config.MaxEquipped)
end

Remotes:WaitForChild("PetsSync").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(pets, equipped)
	if type(pets) ~= "table" or type(equipped) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	currentPets = pets
	currentEquipped = equipped
	renderPets()
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ouverture d'œuf
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Remotes:WaitForChild("HatchResult").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(petName)
	local info = Config.Pets[petName]
	if not info then
		return
	end
	local rarity = Config.Rarities[info.Rarity]
	hatchPopup.PetName.Text = petName
	hatchPopup.Rarity.Text = rarity.Label

--[[
	KIT_Simulator - PetFollow (LocalScript)
	Anime localement TOUS les pets actifs (les siens et ceux des autres)
	derrière leur propriétaire. Le serveur crée/détruit les modèles,
	le client ne fait que l'affichage : fluide et sans coût réseau.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local activePets = workspace:WaitForChild("KIT_Simulator"):WaitForChild("ActivePets")

local RADIUS = 6 -- distance au joueur
local SPREAD = 40 -- écart en degrés entre deux pets
local SMOOTHNESS = 10
local current = {} -- [model] = CFrame actuel

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local alpha = math.clamp(dt * SMOOTHNESS, 0, 1)
	local now = os.clock()
	local pets = activePets:GetChildren()

	local countByOwner = {}
	for _, model in pets do
		local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
		if ownerId then
			countByOwner[ownerId] = (countByOwner[ownerId] or 0) + 1
		end
	end

	local seen = {}
	for _, model in pets do
		local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0
		local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
		local character = owner and owner.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and model:IsA("Model") then
			seen[model] = true
			local slot = model:GetAttribute("Slot") or 1
			local count = countByOwner[ownerId] or 1
			-- arc derrière le joueur (+Z = derrière dans l'espace du personnage)
			local angle = math.rad((slot - (count + 1) / 2) * SPREAD)
			local bob = math.sin(now * 3 + slot) * 0.4
			local position = (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.sin(angle) * RADIUS, -1 + bob, math.cos(angle) * RADIUS)).Position
			local target = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + root.CFrame.LookVector)

			local from = current[model] or target
			local nextCFrame = from:Lerp(target, alpha)
			current[model] = nextCFrame
			model:PivotTo(nextCFrame)
		end
	end

	for model in current do
		if not seen[model] then
			current[model] = nil
		end
	end
end)

# SimulatorKit

Kit « simulator » prêt à l'emploi : entraînement → Force, SellPad → Cash, œuf → pets aléatoires qui suivent le joueur et multiplient les gains, inventaire (équiper/retirer), Rebirth, sauvegarde DataStore.

## Installation

Insère `SimulatorKit.rbxm` dans Studio, puis déplace chaque dossier dans son service (garde les noms) :

| Dans le Model | À mettre dans |
|---|---|
| `Workspace/KIT_Simulator` | Workspace (SellPad + EggStand, déplaçables) |
| `ServerScriptService/KIT_Simulator` | ServerScriptService |
| `ReplicatedStorage/KIT_Simulator` | ReplicatedStorage |
| `StarterGui/KIT_SimulatorHUD` | StarterGui |
| `StarterPlayerScripts/KIT_Simulator` | StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts |

Un script `README` désactivé (en français) est inclus dans le kit avec les mêmes infos.

## Commandes joueur

- **ENTRAÎNER** (bouton bas d'écran ou touche **E**) : + Force
- Marcher sur la dalle **VENDRE** : Force → Cash
- Près de l'œuf, maintenir **F** : ouvre un œuf (50 Cash par défaut)
- Bouton **Pets** (gauche) : inventaire, Équiper / Retirer (3 max)
- Bouton **Rebirth** (gauche) : remet Cash/Force à 0, +50 % de multiplicateur permanent

## Configuration

Tout est dans `ReplicatedStorage.KIT_Simulator.Config` : gains, cooldowns, prix de l'œuf, poids des raretés (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary), liste des pets et leurs bonus, limites d'inventaire, coût et bonus du rebirth, nom du DataStore. Aucun ID de gamepass/produit à remplir.

Pour ajouter un pet : un Model (avec PrimaryPart) dans `Assets/Pets` + une ligne dans `Config.Pets` avec le même nom.

## Architecture

- `SimulatorServer` (ModuleScript serveur) : toute la logique (Train, Sell, Hatch, Equip, Unequip, Rebirth). Les RemoteEvents ne font que demander ; types vérifiés, cooldown anti-spam par joueur et par action, prix/raretés lus uniquement dans la Config côté serveur. La vente passe par le `Touched` serveur du SellPad, l'œuf par le `ProximityPrompt` serveur.
- `PlayerData` (ModuleScript serveur) : `UpdateAsync` uniquement, `pcall` + retry avec backoff, verrou de session (JobId), autosave 60 s, sauvegarde au départ, `BindToClose`. Les données chargées sont nettoyées (types, pets inconnus). En jeu publié, un échec de chargement kick le joueur (jamais d'écrasement de sauvegarde). En Studio sans accès API, le jeu tourne sans sauvegarde (avertissement console).
- `HUDController` (LocalScript) : affichage des stats, inventaire (ViewportFrames), popup d'éclosion, notifications.
- `PetFollow` (LocalScript) : le serveur crée les modèles de pets dans `Workspace.KIT_Simulator.ActivePets`, chaque client les anime localement en arc derrière leur propriétaire (fluide, aucun trafic réseau).
- Multiplicateur = (1 + rebirths × 0,5) × (1 + somme des bonus des pets équipés).

## Origine des assets

- Pets (Bear, Bunny, Fox, Parrot, Dragon, Red Dragon, Crown) et œuf : Tapping Lords Simulator, nettoyés (aucun script, pièces ancrées, sans collision).
- Icônes Pets / Rebirth / Retour et bouton Rebirth : UIMegaPack.
- Code : entièrement neuf (aucun script des jeux d'origine).

local unitTable = {

    Minutes = 60,
    Seconds = 1
}

local searchKeyTable = {}
for key, _ in pairs(unitTable) do
    table.insert(searchKeyTable, key)
end
local unitFinder = Util.MakeFuzzyFinder(searchKeyTable)

local function stringToSecondDuration(stringDuration)
    -- The duration cannot be null or an empty string.
    if stringDuration == nil or stringDuration == "" then
        return nil
    end
    -- Allow 0 by itself (without a unit) to indicate 0 seconds
    local durationNum = tonumber(stringDuration)
    if durationNum and durationNum == 0 then
        return 0, 0, true
    end
    -- The duration must end with a unit,
    -- if it doesn't then return true as the fourth value to indicate the need to offer autocomplete for units.
    local endOnlyString = stringDuration:gsub("-?%d+%a+", "")
    local endNumber = endOnlyString:match("-?%d+")
    if endNumber then
        return nil, tonumber(endNumber), true
    end
    local seconds = nil
    local rawNum, rawUnit
    for rawComponent in stringDuration:gmatch("-?%d+%a+") do
        rawNum, rawUnit = rawComponent:match("(-?%d+)(%a+)")
        local unitNames = unitFinder(rawUnit)
        -- There were no matching units, it's invalid. Return the parsed number to be used for autocomplete
        if #unitNames == 0 then
            return nil, tonumber(rawNum)
        end
        if seconds == nil then seconds = 0 end
        -- While it was already defaulting to use minutes when using just "m", this does it without worrying
        -- about any consistency between list ordering.
        seconds = seconds + (rawUnit:lower() == "m" and 60 or unitTable[unitNames[1]]) * tonumber(rawNum)
    end
    -- If no durations were provided, return nil.
    if seconds == nil then
        return nil
    else
        return seconds, tonumber(rawNum)
    end
end

local function mapUnits(units, rawText, lastNumber, subStart)
    subStart = subStart or 1
    local returnTable = {}
    for i, unit in pairs(units) do
        if lastNumber == 1 then
            returnTable[i] = rawText .. unit:sub(subStart, #unit - 1)
        else
            returnTable[i] = rawText .. unit:sub(subStart)
        end
    end
    return returnTable
end

local durationType = {
    Transform = function(text)
        return text, stringToSecondDuration(text)
    end;

    Validate = function(_, duration)
        return duration ~= nil
    end;

    Autocomplete = function(rawText, duration, lastNumber, isUnitMissing, matchedUnits)
        local returnTable = {}
        if isUnitMissing or matchedUnits then
            local unitsTable = isUnitMissing == true and unitFinder("") or matchedUnits
            if isUnitMissing == true then
                -- Concat the entire unit name to existing text.
                returnTable = mapUnits(unitsTable, rawText, lastNumber)
            else
                -- Concat the rest of the unit based on what already exists of the unit name.
                local existingUnitLength = rawText:match("^.*(%a+)$"):len()
                returnTable = mapUnits(unitsTable, rawText, existingUnitLength + 1)
            end
        elseif duration ~= nil then
            local endingUnit = rawText:match("^.*-?%d+(%a+)$")
            -- Assume there is a singular match at this point
            local fuzzyUnits = unitFinder(endingUnit)
            -- List all possible fuzzy matches. This is for the Minutes/Months ambiguity case.
            returnTable = mapUnits(fuzzyUnits, rawText, lastNumber, #endingUnit + 1)
            -- Sort alphabetically in the Minutes/Months case, so Minutes are displayed on top.
            table.sort(returnTable)
        end
        return returnTable
    end;

    Parse = function(_, duration)
        return duration
    end;
}

local function ShorthandSingle (text, executor)
	if text == "." or text == "me" then
		return {executor}
	elseif text == "?" then
		local players = Players:GetPlayers()
		return {players[math.random(1, #players)]}
	end
end

local function ShorthandMultiple (text, executor)
	if text == "*" or text == "all" then
		return Players:GetPlayers()
	elseif text == "others" then
		local Others = Players:GetPlayers()
		for i = 1, #Others do
			if Others[i] == executor then
				table.remove(Others, i)
				break
			end
		end
		return Others
	end
	
	local randomMatch = text:match("%?(%d+)")
	if randomMatch then
		local maxSize = tonumber(randomMatch)
		if maxSize and maxSize > 0 then
			local players = {}
			local remainingPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
			for i = 1, math.min(maxSize, #remainingPlayers) do
				table.insert(players, table.remove(remainingPlayers, math.random(1, #remainingPlayers)))
			end
			
			return players
		end
	end
end

local function CheckShorthands (text, executor, ...)

return function (Cmdr)
	local AutoComplete = {
		Items = {};
		ItemOptions = {};
		SelectedItem = 0;
	}

	local Util = Cmdr.Util
	local Shorthands = Util.MakeDictionary({"me", "all", ".", "*", "others"})

	local Gui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Cmdr"):WaitForChild("Autocomplete")
	local AutoItem = Gui:WaitForChild("TextButton")
	local Title = Gui:WaitForChild("Title")
	local Description = Gui:WaitForChild("Description")
	local Entry = Gui.Parent:WaitForChild("Frame"):WaitForChild("Entry")
	AutoItem.Parent = nil

	-- Helper function that sets text and resizes labels
	local function SetText(obj, textObj, text, sizeFromContents)
		obj.Visible = text ~= nil
		textObj.Text = text or ""

		if sizeFromContents then
			textObj.Size = UDim2.new(0, Util.GetTextSize(text or "", textObj, Vector2.new(1000, 1000), 1, 0).X, obj.Size.Y.Scale, obj.Size.Y.Offset)
		end
	end

	-- Update the info display (Name, type, and description) based on given options.
	local function UpdateInfoDisplay (options)
		-- Update the objects' text and sizes
		SetText(Title, Title.Field, options.name, true)
		SetText(Title.Field.Type, Title.Field.Type, options.type and ": " .. options.type:sub(1, 1):upper() .. options.type:sub(2))
		SetText(Description, Description.Label, options.description)

		Description.Label.TextColor3 = options.invalid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 73, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		-- Calculate needed width and height
		local infoWidth = Title.Field.TextBounds.X + Title.Field.Type.TextBounds.X

		local guiWidth = math.max(infoWidth, Gui.Size.X.Offset)
		Description.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)

		-- Flow description text
		while not Description.Label.TextFits do
			Description.Size = Description.Size + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)

			if Description.Size.Y.Offset > 500 then
				break
			end
		end

		-- Update container
		wait()
		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, guiWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
	end

	--- Shows the auto complete menu with the given list and possible options
	-- item = {typedText, suggestedText, options?=options}
	-- The options table is optional. `at` should only be passed into AutoComplete::Show
	-- name, type, and description may be passed in an options dictionary inside the items as well
	-- options.at?: the character index at which to show the menu
	-- options.name?: The name to display in the info box
	-- options.type?: The type to display in the info box
	-- options.prefix?: The current type prefix (%Team)
	-- options.description?: The description for the currently active info box
	-- options.invalid?: If true, description is shown in red.
	-- options.isLast?: If true, auto complete won't keep going after this argument.
	function AutoComplete:Show (items, options)
		options = options or {}

		-- Remove old options.
		for _, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			if item.gui then
				item.gui:Destroy()
			end
		end

		-- Reset state
		self.SelectedItem = 1
		self.Items = items
		self.Prefix = options.prefix or ""
		self.LastItem = options.isLast or false
		self.Command = options.command
		self.Arg = options.arg
		self.NumArgs = options.numArgs
		self.IsPartial = options.isPartial

		-- Generate the new option labels
		local autocompleteWidth = 200

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			local leftText = item[1]
			local rightText = item[2]

			if Shorthands[leftText] then
				leftText = rightText
			end

			local btn = AutoItem:Clone()
			btn.Name = leftText .. rightText
			btn.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
			btn.Typed.Text = leftText
			btn.Suggest.Text = string.rep(" ", #leftText) .. rightText:sub(#leftText + 1)
			btn.Parent = Gui
			btn.LayoutOrder = i

			local maxBounds = math.max(btn.Typed.TextBounds.X, btn.Suggest.TextBounds.X) + 20
			if maxBounds > autocompleteWidth then
				autocompleteWidth = maxBounds
			end

			item.gui = btn
		end

		Gui.UIListLayout:ApplyLayout()

		-- Todo: Use TextService to find accurate position for auto complete box
		local text = Entry.TextBox.Text
		local words = Util.SplitString(text)
		if text:sub(#text, #text) == " " and not options.at then
			words[#words+1] = "e"
		end
		table.remove(words, #words)
		local extra = (options.at and options.at or (#table.concat(words, " ") + 1)) * 7

		-- Update the auto complete container
		Gui.Position = UDim2.new(0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.X - 10 + extra, 0, Entry.TextBox.AbsolutePosition.Y + 30)
		Gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, autocompleteWidth, 0, Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
		Gui.Visible = true

		-- Finally, update thge info display
		UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[1] and self.Items[1].options or options)
	end

	--- Returns the selected item in the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem ()
		if Gui.Visible == false then
			return nil
		end

		return AutoComplete.Items[AutoComplete.SelectedItem]
	end

	--- Hides the auto complete
	function AutoComplete:Hide ()
		Gui.Visible = false
	end

	--- Returns if the menu is visible
	function AutoComplete:IsVisible ()
		return Gui.Visible
	end

	--- Changes the user's item selection by the given delta
	function AutoComplete:Select (delta)
		if not Gui.Visible then return end

		self.SelectedItem = self.SelectedItem + delta

		if self.SelectedItem > #self.Items then
			self.SelectedItem = 1
		elseif self.SelectedItem < 1 then
			self.SelectedItem = #self.Items
		end

		for i, item in pairs(self.Items) do
			item.gui.BackgroundTransparency = i == self.SelectedItem and 0.5 or 1
		end

		if self.Items[self.SelectedItem] and self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options then
			UpdateInfoDisplay(self.Items[self.SelectedItem].options or {})
		end
	end

	return AutoComplete
end

--- Window handles the command bar GUI

--- Update the text entry label
function Window:UpdateLabel()
	Entry.TextLabel.Text = Player.Name .. "@" .. self.Cmdr.PlaceName .. "$"
	Entry.TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, Entry.TextLabel.TextBounds.X, 0, 20)
	Entry.TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, Entry.TextLabel.Size.X.Offset + 7, 0, 0)
end

--- Get the text entry label
function Window:GetLabel()
	return Entry.TextLabel.Text
end

--- Recalculate the window height
function Window:UpdateWindowHeight()
	local windowHeight = LINE_HEIGHT

	for _, child in pairs(Gui:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			windowHeight = windowHeight + child.Size.Y.Offset
		end
	end

	Gui.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(Gui.CanvasSize.X.Scale, Gui.CanvasSize.X.Offset, 0, windowHeight)
	Gui.Size =
		UDim2.new(
		Gui.Size.X.Scale,
		Gui.Size.X.Offset,
		0,
		windowHeight > WINDOW_MAX_HEIGHT and WINDOW_MAX_HEIGHT or windowHeight
	)

	Gui.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(windowHeight - 300, 0, math.huge))
end

--- Add a line to the command bar
function Window:AddLine(text, color)
	if #text == 0 then
		Window:UpdateWindowHeight()
		return
	end

	local str = self.Cmdr.Util.EmulateTabstops(text or "nil", 8)
	local line = Line:Clone()
	line.Size =
		UDim2.new(
		line.Size.X.Scale,
		line.Size.X.Offset,
		0,
		TextService:GetTextSize(
			str,
			line.TextSize,
			line.Font,
			Vector2.new(Gui.UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.X, math.huge)
		).Y + (LINE_HEIGHT - line.TextSize)
	)
	line.Text = str
	line.TextColor3 = color or line.TextColor3
	line.Parent = Gui
end

--- Returns if the command bar is visible
function Window:IsVisible()
	return Gui.Visible
end

--- Sets the command bar visible or not
function Window:SetVisible(visible)
	Gui.Visible = visible

	if visible then
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
		self:SetEntryText("")

		if self.Cmdr.ActivationUnlocksMouse then
			self.PreviousMouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		end
	else
		Entry.TextBox:ReleaseFocus()
		self.AutoComplete:Hide()

		if self.PreviousMouseBehavior then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = self.PreviousMouseBehavior
			self.PreviousMouseBehavior = nil
		end
	end
end

--- Hides the command bar
function Window:Hide()
	return self:SetVisible(false)
end

--- Shows the command bar
function Window:Show()
	return self:SetVisible(true)
end

--- Sets the text in the command bar text box, and captures focus
function Window:SetEntryText(text)
	Entry.TextBox.Text = text

	if self:IsVisible() then
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
		Entry.TextBox.CursorPosition = #text + 1
	end
end

--- Gets the text in the command bar text box
function Window:GetEntryText()
	return Entry.TextBox.Text:gsub("\t", "")
end

--- Sets whether the command is in a valid state or not.
-- Cannot submit if in invalid state.
function Window:SetIsValidInput(isValid, errorText)
	Entry.TextBox.TextColor3 = isValid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 73, 73)
	self.Valid = isValid
	self._errorText = errorText
end

--- Event handler for text box focus lost
function Window:LoseFocus(submit)
	local text = Entry.TextBox.Text

	self:ClearHistoryState()

	if Gui.Visible and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		-- self:SetEntryText("")
		Entry.TextBox:CaptureFocus()
	elseif GuiService.MenuIsOpen and Gui.Visible then
		self:Hide()
	end

	if submit and self.Valid then
		wait()
		self:SetEntryText("")
		self.ProcessEntry(text)
	elseif submit then
		self:AddLine(self._errorText, Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 153))
	end
end

function Window:TraverseHistory(delta)
	local history = self.Cmdr.Dispatcher:GetHistory()

	if self.HistoryState == nil then
		self.HistoryState = {
			Position = #history + 1;
			InitialText = self:GetEntryText();
		}
	end

	self.HistoryState.Position = math.clamp(self.HistoryState.Position + delta, 1, #history + 1)

	self:SetEntryText(
		self.HistoryState.Position == #history + 1
			and self.HistoryState.InitialText
			or history[self.HistoryState.Position]
	)
end

function Window:ClearHistoryState()
	self.HistoryState = nil
end

function Window:SelectVertical(delta)
	if self.AutoComplete:IsVisible() and not self.HistoryState then
		self.AutoComplete:Select(delta)
	else
		self:TraverseHistory(delta)
	end
end

local lastPressTime = 0
local pressCount = 0
--- Handles user input when the box is focused
function Window:BeginInput(input, gameProcessed)
	if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		self:Hide()
	end

	if gameProcessed and self:IsVisible() == false then
		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.ActivationKeys[input.KeyCode] then -- Activate the command bar
		if self.Cmdr.MashToEnable and not self.Cmdr.Enabled then
			if tick() - lastPressTime < 1 then
				if pressCount >= 5 then
					return self.Cmdr:SetEnabled(true)
				else
					pressCount = pressCount + 1
				end
			else
				pressCount = 1
			end
			lastPressTime = tick()
		elseif self.Cmdr.Enabled then
			self:SetVisible(not self:IsVisible())
			wait()
			self:SetEntryText("")

			if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then -- Special case for menu getting stuck open (roblox bug)
				self:Hide()
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.Enabled == false or not self:IsVisible() then
		if self:IsVisible() then
			self:Hide()
		end

		return
	end

	if self.Cmdr.HideOnLostFocus and table.find(MOUSE_TOUCH_ENUM, input.UserInputType) then
		local ps = input.Position
		local ap = Gui.AbsolutePosition
		local as = Gui.AbsoluteSize
		if ps.X < ap.X or ps.X > ap.X + as.X or ps.Y < ap.Y or ps.Y > ap.Y + as.Y then
			self:Hide()
		end
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then -- Auto Complete Down
		self:SelectVertical(1)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then -- Auto Complete Up
		self:SelectVertical(-1)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then -- Eat new lines
		wait()
		self:SetEntryText(self:GetEntryText():gsub("\n", ""):gsub("\r", ""))
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then -- Auto complete
		local item = self.AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem()
		local text = self:GetEntryText()
		if item and not (text:sub(#text, #text):match("%s") and self.AutoComplete.LastItem) then
			local replace = item[2]
			local newText
			local insertSpace = true
			local command = self.AutoComplete.Command

			if command then
				local lastArg = self.AutoComplete.Arg

				newText = command.Alias
				insertSpace = self.AutoComplete.NumArgs ~= #command.ArgumentDefinitions and self.AutoComplete.IsPartial == false

				local args = command.Arguments
				for i = 1, #args do
					local arg = args[i]
					local segments = arg.RawSegments
					if arg == lastArg then
						segments[#segments] = replace
					end

					local argText = arg.Prefix .. table.concat(segments, ",")

					-- Put auto completion options in quotation marks if they have a space
					if argText:find(" ") then
						argText = ("%q"):format(argText)
					end

					newText = ("%s %s"):format(newText, argText)

					if arg == lastArg then
						break
					end
				end
			else
				newText = replace
			end
			-- need to wait a frame so we can eat the \t
			wait()
			-- Update the text box
			self:SetEntryText(newText .. (insertSpace and " " or ""))
		else
			-- Still need to eat the \t even if there is no auto-complete to show
			wait()
			self:SetEntryText(self:GetEntryText())
		end
	else
		self:ClearHistoryState()
	end
end

)
