-- [Functions] --
function BossFight:InRegion()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Objects = {}
		local FoundPlayer = false
		for _,v in pairs(BossFightFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local Filter = OverlapParams.new()
			
			Filter.FilterDescendantsInstances = {v}
			Filter.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
			
			local CF, Size = v.CFrame, v.Size

			for _,Object in pairs(Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CF, Size, Filter)) do
				if Object.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
					Objects[#Objects + 1] = Object
					if Object.Parent.Name == Player.Name then
						script.InRegion.Value = tonumber(v.Name)
						FoundPlayer = true
					else
						if FoundPlayer == false then
							script.InRegion.Value = 0
						end
					end		
				end
			end
		end
		if #Objects == 0 then
			if FoundPlayer == false then
				script.InRegion.Value = 0
			end
		end
	end)
end

function BossFight:Update()
	script.InRegion:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
			MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Visible = true
			local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue2.Value) * BossFightFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Multiplier.Value
			MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Gems.Text = "Cost: "..Utility.Suffixes(Cost).." Strength"
		else
			MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Visible = false
		end
	end)
	
	local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue2.Value)
	MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Gems.Text = "Cost: "..Utility.Suffixes(Cost).." Strength"
	MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Strength.Text = "Wins: "..Utility.Suffixes(Player.Stats.Wins.Value)
	Player.Stats.Wins:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
			local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue2.Value) * BossFightFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Multiplier.Value

			MainUI.Bottom.BossFight.Strength.Text = "Wins: "..Utility.Suffixes(Player.Stats.Wins.Value)
		end
	end)
end

	ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlayBossFight.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Strength)
		if LastAnimation == 1 then
			local Tries = 5
			repeat 
				Tries -= 1

				if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
					local Items = BossFightFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Hit:GetChildren()
					local Tween = TweenService:Create(workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name).BodyPosition, TweenInfo.new(.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{Position = Items[math.random(1, #Items)].Position}

				end
			end
			local AnimationTrack = Player.Character.Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			:LoadAnimation(ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlayBossFight.Left)
			AnimationTrack:Play()
			LastAnimation = 2
		else
			local Tries = 5
			repeat 
				Tries -= 1
				task.wait() 
			until Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)  or Tries <= 0
			if Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name) then		
				if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
					local Items = BossFightFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Hit:GetChildren()
					local Tween = TweenService:Create(workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name).BodyPosition, TweenInfo.new(.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),

			AnimationTrack:Play()
			LastAnimation = 1
		end

local DoubleJump = {}

-- [Services] --
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- [Variables] --
repeat task.wait() until Players.LocalPlayer
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local JumpDebounce = false
local CanDoubleJump = false

local Animation = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator"):LoadAnimation(script.Animation)

local maxJumps = 1
local currentJumps = 0
local timeJump = 0.05
local jumpMulti = 2
local sidewaysForce = 70
local upwardsForce = 30
local normalJumpPower = 50

-- [Functions] --
function DoubleJump:Int()
	UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		if JumpDebounce == false and CanDoubleJump == true then
			JumpDebounce = true
			if currentJumps < maxJumps then
				Humanoid.JumpPower = normalJumpPower * jumpMulti
				Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
				HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(Humanoid.MoveDirection.X * sidewaysForce, upwardsForce, Humanoid.MoveDirection.Z * sidewaysForce)
				Animation:Play()
				Animation:AdjustSpeed(1.25)

				currentJumps = currentJumps + 1
				CanDoubleJump = false
				task.wait(.2)
				JumpDebounce = false	
			end
		end
	end)
	
	Humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(oldState, newState)
		Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
		Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
		if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
			if CanDoubleJump == true then
				CanDoubleJump = false
				Humanoid.JumpPower = normalJumpPower
				currentJumps = 0
				JumpDebounce = false
			end
		elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
			if currentJumps <= 0 then
				task.wait(.2)
				CanDoubleJump = true
			else
				task.wait(timeJump)
				CanDoubleJump = true
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DoubleJump

-- [Functions] --
function Error:Create(Type, Message)
	local Clone = ErrorFrame[Type]:Clone()
	Clone.Size = UDim2.new()
	Clone.Parent = Holder
	Clone.Label.Text = Message
	Clone.Visible = true
	local TextResizeTween = TweenService:Create(Clone, TweenInfo.new(.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1)
	})
	TextResizeTween:Play()
	task.wait(2)
	if not Clone then return end
	local Tween = TweenService:Create(Clone.Label, TweenInfo.new(05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
		TextTransparency = 1
	})
	local Tween2 = TweenService:Create(Clone, TweenInfo.new(05, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
		Transparency = 1
	})

	Tween:Play()
	Tween2:Play()
	task.wait(1)
	TextResizeTween:Destroy()
	Tween:Destroy()
	Tween2:Destroy()
	Clone:Destroy()
end

function Error:Int()
	ReplicatedStorage.Events.Error.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Type, Message)
		self:Create(Type, Message)
	end)
end

-- [Functions] --
function GameShop:Choose()
	for _,v in ipairs(Left:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") then
			Buttton:BindDown(v.Click, function()
				v:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.95, 0, .428), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
			end)
			Buttton:BindUp(v.Click, function()
				v:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1, 0, .45), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
				Holder.Ranks.Visible = false
				Holder.Upgrades.Visible = false
				Holder[v.Name].Visible = true

				Right.Ranks.Visible = false
				Right.Upgrades.Visible = false
				Right[v.Name].Visible = true
			end)
		end
	end
end

function GameShop:Update_Upgrades()
	for _,v in ipairs(UpgradesFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") then
			v.Main.TextLabel.Text = 
				Player.Upgrades[v.Name].Value.."/"..#UpgradesShop[v.Name].Cost
		end
	end
	if Player.Upgrades[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Value >= #UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Cost then
		Right.Upgrades.Buy.Label.Text = "Max"
		Right.Upgrades.Icon.Label.Text = "Maxed Out"
	else
		Right.Upgrades.Icon.Label.Text = 
			Player.Upgrades[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Value.."/"..#UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Cost
		Right.Upgrades.Buy.Label.Text = 
			Utility.Suffixes(UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Cost[Player.Upgrades[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Value + 1])
	end
end

function GameShop:Upgrades()
	for _,v in ipairs(UpgradesFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") then
			Buttton:BindDown(v.Click, function()
				v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.9, 0, .9), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
			end)
			Buttton:BindUp(v.Click, function()
				v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1, 0, 1), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
				GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value = v.Name
			end)
		end
	end
	GameShopFrame.Upgrades:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		Right.Upgrades.Icon.Icon.Image = UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Icon
		Right.Upgrades.Title.Text = UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Title
		Right.Upgrades.Desc.Text = UpgradesShop[GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value].Desc
		self:Update_Upgrades()	
	end)

	Buttton:BindDown(Right.Upgrades.Buy.Click, function()
		Right.Upgrades.Buy:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.813, 0, .145), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
	end)
	Buttton:BindUp(Right.Upgrades.Buy.Click, function()
		Right.Upgrades.Buy:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.859, 0, .153), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		local Result = ReplicatedStorage.Functions.Upgrade:InvokeServer(GameShopFrame.Upgrades.Value)
		if Result == "Success" then
			self:Update_Upgrades()
		elseif Result == "Wins" then
			Error:Create("Err", "You don't have enough Wins!")
		end
	end)
end

function GameShop:Update_Ranks()
	for _,v in ipairs(RanksFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") then
			if (Player.Ranks.Tier.Value + 1) < tonumber(v.Name) then
				v.Locked.Visible = true
			else
				v.Locked.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

	if Player.Ranks.Tier.Value >= tonumber(GameShopFrame.Ranks.Value) then
		Right.Ranks.Owned.Visible = true
		Right.Ranks.Buy.Visible = false
	else
		Right.Ranks.Buy.Main.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(Ranks[tonumber(GameShopFrame.Ranks.Value)].Cost)
		Right.Ranks.Buy.Visible = true
		Right.Ranks.Owned.Visible = false
	end

		if v:IsA("Frame") then

					v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.9, 0, .9), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
				end
			end)
			Buttton:BindUp(v.Click, function()
				if (Player.Ranks.Tier.Value + 1) >= tonumber(v.Name) then
					v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1, 0, 1), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
					GameShopFrame.Ranks.Value = v.Name
				end
			end)
		end

		Right.Ranks.Icon.Icon.Image = Ranks[tonumber(GameShopFrame.Ranks.Value)].Icon

function Music:Int()
	local SongsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Music")
	local Table = {}
	local LastSong = nil
	local ChosenSong = nil
	MusicSettings:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if MusicSettings.Value == false then
			ChosenSong.Volume = 0
		else
			ChosenSong.Volume = 0.12
		end
	end)

	for _,v in pairs(SongsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Sound") then
			table.insert(Table, v)
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for a,c in pairs(Table) do
				ChosenSong = Table[math.random(1,#Table)]
				repeat task.wait() ChosenSong = Table[math.random(1,#Table)] until ChosenSong ~= LastSong
				LastSong = ChosenSong
				ChosenSong:Play()
				if MusicSettings.Value == false then
					ChosenSong.Volume = 0
				end
				ChosenSong.Ended:Wait()
				ChosenSong:Stop()
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

return Music

local function SimpleTween(instance, tweenInfo, props, yield)
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(instance, tweenInfo, props)
	tween:Play()

	if yield then
		tween.Completed:Wait()
		tween:Destroy()
	else
		task.spawn(function()
			tween.Completed:Wait()
			tween:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	return tween
end

function Hatching:Hatch(Type, Egg, Result, Craft)
	if script.Choosed.Value == "None" or Egg == "None" then return end
	for _,v in ipairs(PetInfo:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("Frame") then v.Deleted.Visible = false end end
	for _,v in pairs(Workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren()) do v.PrimaryPart.UI.Enabled = false end
	UI()
	UIModule:CloseAllAnother("None")
	ViewFrame.Main.Visible = false
	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 9
	ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	local HatchSpeed = 1.7
	local Number = 1
	if Type == "Triple" then Number = 3 end
	for i = 1,Number do
		task.spawn(function()
			local Egg = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Eggs[Egg]:Clone()
			Egg.Parent = Workspace

			local VectorNumber, PetVector, PetRotate = 0, 0, 0
			if i == 2 then
				VectorNumber, PetVector, PetRotate = -1.08, -4, 35
			elseif i == 3 then
				VectorNumber, PetVector, PetRotate = 1.08, 4, -35
			end

			local Pos = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			--local Y = tonumber(Egg.PrimaryPart.Orientation.Y)
			local Con = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				Egg:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(VectorNumber, 0, -1.5) * Pos.Value)
			end)
			Pos.Value = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
			SimpleTween(Pos, TweenInfo.new(.15/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Value = CFrame.new()}, true)

			task.wait(.1/HatchSpeed)

			local CountLeft = 5
			repeat
				CountLeft -= 1
				SimpleTween(Pos, TweenInfo.new(.15/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Value = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(20))}
				)
				if Player.Settings.Sounds.Value == true then
					ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake:Stop()
					ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake:Play()
					ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake.PlaybackSpeed += 0.05
				end
				task.wait((CountLeft / 15) / HatchSpeed)
				SimpleTween(Pos, TweenInfo.new(.15/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Value = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-20))}
				)
				if Player.Settings.Sounds.Value == true then
					if CountLeft > 0 then
						ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake:Stop()
					end
					ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.EggShake:Play()
				end
				task.wait((CountLeft / 15) / HatchSpeed)
			until CountLeft == 1
			SimpleTween(Pos, TweenInfo.new(.15/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Value = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(0))}, true)

			Con:Disconnect()
			Egg:Destroy()

			local NewResult = Result
			if type(Result) == "table" then NewResult = Result[i] end 
			local Crafting = "Normal"
			if Type == "Single" then Crafting = Eggs.Settings.Ranks[Craft].Name else Crafting = Eggs.Settings.Ranks[Craft[i]].Name end
			local Pet = Characters[NewResult][Crafting]:Clone()
			Pet.PrimaryPart.UI:Destroy()
			Pet.Parent = Workspace

			PetInfo.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, .5)
			PetInfo.Visible = true
			PetInfo[i].Visible = true
			PetInfo[i].PetName.Text = NewResult
			local Gradient = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Gradients.Hatch[Eggs.Pets[NewResult].Rank]:Clone()
			Gradient.Name = "Rank"
			Gradient.Parent = PetInfo[i]
			if string.find(Player.Settings.AutoDelete.Value, NewResult) then
				PetInfo[i].Deleted.Visible = true
			end

			for _,v in ipairs(Pet:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored = true v.CanCollide = false end end

			Con = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				Pet:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(PetVector, 0, -5.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(PetRotate), 0) * Pos.Value)
			end)
			
			if script:FindFirstChild(Eggs.Pets[NewResult].Rank) then script[Eggs.Pets[NewResult].Rank]:Play() end
			task.wait(1/HatchSpeed)
			SimpleTween(Pos, TweenInfo.new(.3/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Value = CFrame.new(0, -10, 0)})
			SimpleTween(PetInfo, TweenInfo.new(.3/HatchSpeed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, 1.5)}, true)
			
			PetInfo[i].Rank:Destroy()
			--PetInfo[i].Deleted.Visible = false
			Con:Disconnect()
			Pet:Destroy()
			if i == 1 then
				for _,v in ipairs(PetInfo:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("Frame") then v.Visible = false end end
				Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = .5
				UI(true)
				for _,v in pairs(Workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren()) do v.PrimaryPart.UI.Enabled = true end
				task.wait(.2)
				ViewFrame.Main.Visible = true
			end
		end)
	end
end

	for i,v in pairs(Eggs.Eggs[script.Choosed.Value].Pets) do Pets[#Pets + 1] = {Name = i, Settings = v} end
	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b) return b.Settings.Multiplier > a.Settings.Multiplier end)

		ViewFrame.Main.Wins.Main.Cost.Visible = false
		ViewFrame.Main.Wins.Main.Label.Visible = true
		ViewFrame.Main.Wins.Wins.Visible = true
	end
	
	ReplicatedStorage.Events.Delete:FireServer("Clear")
	for i = 1,#Pets do
		if Pets[i].Settings.Secret == false then
			local Template = ViewFrame.Main.Template:Clone()
			Template.Name = Pets[i].Name
			local Model = Characters:FindFirstChild(Pets[i].Name)["Normal"]
			local VP = Module3D:Attach3D(Template.Main.Top.ViewportFrame, Model:Clone())

			UICorner.Parent = Template.Main.Top.ViewportFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ViewportFrame")

				Template.Main.Top.Percentage.Text = Utility.Round(Pets[i].Settings.Rarity * Upgrades.Check(Player, "Luck"), 4).."%"
			end

			end

			Template.Main.Click.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
				if Template.Main.Top.AutoDelete.Visible == false then

					ReplicatedStorage.Events.Delete:FireServer("Add", Pets[i].Name)
				else
					Template.Main.Top.AutoDelete.Visible = false
					ReplicatedStorage.Events.Delete:FireServer("Clear")
					for _,v in pairs(ViewFrame.Main.Holder:GetChildren()) do
						if v:IsA("ImageLabel") then
							if v.Main.Top.AutoDelete.Visible == true then
								ReplicatedStorage.Events.Delete:FireServer("Add", v.Name)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)

			Template.Parent = ViewFrame.Main.Holder
		end 
	end
end

function Hatching:View()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			local EggsAvailable = {}
			local Closest
			local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/13
			for _,v in ipairs(Workspace.Eggs:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Egg and v.Egg.PrimaryPart and Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					local Magnitude = (v.Egg.PrimaryPart.Position - Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
					if Magnitude <= 10 then
						EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = v
						Closest = v
					end
				else
					print(v.Name)
				end
			end
			if #EggsAvailable == 1 then
				local Egg = EggsAvailable[1]
				local WSP = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg.Egg.PrimaryPart.Position)
				ViewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
				ViewFrame.Visible = true
				script.Choosed.Value = Egg.Name
			elseif #EggsAvailable > 1 then
				local WSP = Camera:WorldToScreenPoint(Closest.Egg.PrimaryPart.Position)
				ViewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
				ViewFrame.Visible = true
				script.Choosed.Value = Closest.Name
			else
				ViewFrame.Visible = false
				script.Choosed.Value = "None"
			end
			ViewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(Default_Size.X.Scale/CameraRatio, 0, Default_Size.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, 0)
		end
	end)
end

function Hatching:Result(Type)
	if Type ~= "Auto" then
		if ViewFrame.Main.Visible == true then
			local Hatch = tostring(script.Choosed.Value)
			local Result, Craft = UnboxRemote:InvokeServer(Hatch, Type)
			if Result and Result ~= "Wins" and Result ~= "Space" then
				self:Hatch(Type, Hatch, Result, Craft)
			elseif Result == "Wins" then
				Error:Create("Err", "You don't have enough Wins!")
			elseif Result == "Space" then
				Error:Create("Err", "You don't have enough space inventory!")
			end
		end
	else
		local Success, Err = pcall(function()
			if Player:IsInGroup(16734444) then
				if AutoHatch == true then return end 
				AutoHatch = true
				local Result, Craft
				while script.Choosed.Value ~= "None" do
					if ViewFrame.Main.Visible == true then
						local Hatch = tostring(script.Choosed.Value)
						Result, Craft = UnboxRemote:InvokeServer(Hatch, "Triple")
					if Result and Result ~= "Wins" and Result ~= "Space" then
							self:Hatch("Triple", Hatch, Result, Craft)
						elseif Result == "Wins" then
							Error:Create("Err", "You don't have enough Wins!")
							task.wait(3)
						elseif Result == "Space" then
							Error:Create("Err", "You don't have enough space inventory!")
							break
						else break end
					end
					task.wait(.2)
				end
				AutoHatch = false
			else 
				UIModule:OpenUI("GroupInfo")
			end
		end)
	end
end

function Hatching:Interface()
	ViewFrame.Main.Buttons.E.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		self:Result("Single") 
	end)
	ViewFrame.Main.Buttons.R.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		self:Result("Triple") 
	end)
	ViewFrame.Main.Buttons.T.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		self:Result("Auto") 
	end)
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
		if not Processed then
			if script.Choosed.Value ~= "None" then
				if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
					return self:Result("Triple") 
				elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
					return self:Result("Auto")
				elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
					return self:Result("Single")
				elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
					return self:Result("Triple")
				elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
					return self:Result("Auto")
				elseif Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
					return self:Result("Single")
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function Hatching:Int()
	self:View()
	self:Interface()
	script.Choosed:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if script.Choosed.Value ~= "None" then self:Update() end	
	end)
	
	Button:BindDown(MainUI.GroupInfoFrame.Holder.Buy.Click, function()
		MainUI.GroupInfoFrame.Holder.Buy:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.416, 0, .185), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
	end)
	Button:BindUp(MainUI.GroupInfoFrame.Holder.Buy.Click, function()
		MainUI.GroupInfoFrame.Holder.Buy:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.44, 0, .196), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		UIModule:CloseAllAnother("None")
	end)
	
	ReplicatedStorage.Functions.Unbox.OnClientInvoke = function(Type, Egg, Result, Craft)
		return self:Hatch(Type, Egg, Result, Craft)
	end
end

return Hatching

function Inventory:Layout(Multiplier)
	Multiplier += 1
	Multiplier = math.log10(Multiplier)
	Multiplier *= 1000
	
	return -Multiplier
end

function Inventory:GetAllCraft(Folder)
	local Amount = 0
	for _,v in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do
		if v.PetName.Value == Folder.PetName.Value then 
			if v.Type.Value == Folder.Type.Value then Amount += 1 end
		end
	end
	return Amount
end

function Inventory:Stats()
	local Equipped = 0
	local Storage = #PlayerPets:GetChildren()
	for _,v in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do if v.Equipped.Value == true then Equipped += 1 end end
	PetsFrame.Equipped.Text = tostring(math.floor(Equipped)).."/"..tostring(math.floor(Player.Data.MaxEquip.Value))
	MainUI.Right.Pets.TextUpper.Text = 
		tostring(math.floor(Equipped)).."/"..tostring(math.floor(Player.Data.MaxEquip.Value))
	if Equipped == 0 then
		PetsFrame.Additional.Best.UnequipAll.Visible = false
		PetsFrame.Additional.Best.EquipBest.Visible = true
		script.EquippedBest.Value = false
	else
		PetsFrame.Additional.Best.UnequipAll.Visible = true
		PetsFrame.Additional.Best.EquipBest.Visible = false
		script.EquippedBest.Value = true
	end
	PetsFrame.Storage.Text = tostring(Storage).."/"..tostring(Player.Data.MaxStorage.Value)
end

		end

	end)

	Template.Parent = Scrolling

function Inventory:Information()
	Mouse.Move:Connect(function()
		Information.Visible = false
		local GuiObjects = PlayerGUI:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
		for _,v in pairs(GuiObjects) do
			if v:IsA("GuiButton") and v.Name == "Click_Pet" then
				Information.Visible = true
			end
		end
		Information.Position = UDim2.new(Mouse.X/Mouse.ViewSizeX + .07, 0, Mouse.Y/Mouse.ViewSizeY + .07)
	end)
end

function Inventory:Int()
	self:Information()
	self:Additional()
	self:Right()
	for _,v in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do
		self:Create(v)
	end
	self:Stats()
	PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Folder)
		task.delay(.1, function()
			self:Create(Folder)
		end)
	end)
	PlayerPets.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Folder)
		if Scrolling:FindFirstChild(Folder.Name) then
			Scrolling[Folder.Name]:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	Choosed:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if Choosed.Value == 0 then self:Spread(false) return end
		self:Update(PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(tostring(Choosed.Value)))
	end)
	PetsFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if PetsFrame.Visible == true then self:Stats() end
	end)
	
	Player.Data.MaxEquip:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function() self:Stats() end)
	Player.Data.MaxStorage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function() self:Stats() end)
end

return Inventory

function Movement:HYP()
	Player.Settings.HideYourPets:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		RequestEvent:FireServer("Load", {PetID = 0})
	end)
end

function Movement:HOP()
	if Player.Settings.HideOtherPets.Value == true then
		for _,v in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= Player.Name then
				v.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Hide
			end
		end
	end
	PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		if Player.Settings.HideOtherPets.Value == true then
			task.wait(.1)
			if Object.Name ~= Player.Name then
				Object.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Hide
			end
		end
	end)
	Player.Settings.HideOtherPets:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if Player.Settings.HideOtherPets.Value == true then
			for _,v in ipairs(PlayerPets:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Name ~= Player.Name then
					v.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Hide
				end
			end
		else
			for _,v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Hide:GetChildren()) do
				v.Parent = PlayerPets
			end
		end
	end)
end

function Movement:Int()
	self:HOP()
	self:HYP()
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name) then
			for i,v in ipairs(PlayerPetsFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if not v.PrimaryPart then continue end
				v.PrimaryPart.BodyPosition.Position = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + 
					Vector3.new(0, .5, 0) +
					(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame - Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
					:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(if i == 1 or i == 4 or i == 7 or i == 10 or i == 13 or i == 16 or i == 19 or i == 22 then 0 elseif (i % 3) == 0 then -5 else 5, 0, if i > 3 and i < 7 then 10 elseif i > 6 and i < 10 then 15 elseif i > 9 and i < 13 then 20 elseif i > 12 and i < 16 then 25 elseif i > 15 and i < 19 then 30 else 5))
				v.PrimaryPart.BodyGyro.CFrame = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Movement

-- [Functions] --
function PopUp:Create(Type, Amount)
	if Type == "Muscle" then
		local Template = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.MusclePopUp:Clone()
		
		local StartPosition = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
		local RandomX, RandomY, RandomZ = math.random(2,6), math.random(0,1), math.random(2,6)
		local TotallyRandomPosition = math.random(1,4)
		local EndPosition
		if TotallyRandomPosition == 1 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X + RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z + RandomZ)
		elseif TotallyRandomPosition == 2 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X - RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z + RandomZ)
		elseif TotallyRandomPosition == 3 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X + RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z - RandomZ)
		else
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X - RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z - RandomZ)
		end
		
		Template.Position = StartPosition
		Template.Parent = Workspace
		if Amount < 1000 then
			Template.BillboardGui.Label.Text = "+"..Utility.Round(Amount, 1).." Muscle"
		else
			Template.BillboardGui.Label.Text = "+"..Utility.Suffixes(Amount).." Muscle"
		end
		Template.BillboardGui.Label.Size = UDim2.new()
		local Tween1 = TweenService:Create(Template, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Position = EndPosition})
		Tween1:Play()
		Template.BillboardGui.Label:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.7, 0, .5), 'Out', 'Quad', .1, true)
		local TextTween = TweenService:Create(Template.BillboardGui.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Rotation = 360})
		TextTween:Play()
		task.wait(1)
		local Tween2 = TweenService:Create(Template, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Position = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position})
		Tween2:Play()
		local TextTween2 = TweenService:Create(Template.BillboardGui.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Rotation = 0})
		TextTween2:Play()
		Template.BillboardGui.Label:TweenSize(UDim2.new(), 'Out', 'Quad', .1, true)
		task.wait(.1)
		Tween1:Destroy()
		Tween2:Destroy()
		TextTween:Destroy()
		TextTween2:Destroy()
		Template:Destroy()
	elseif Type == "Wins" then
		local Template = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.WinsPopUp:Clone()

		local StartPosition = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
		local RandomX, RandomY, RandomZ = math.random(2,6), math.random(0,1), math.random(2,6)
		local TotallyRandomPosition = math.random(1,4)
		local EndPosition
		if TotallyRandomPosition == 1 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X + RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z + RandomZ)
		elseif TotallyRandomPosition == 2 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X - RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z + RandomZ)
		elseif TotallyRandomPosition == 3 then
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X + RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z - RandomZ)
		else
			EndPosition = Vector3.new(StartPosition.X - RandomX, StartPosition.Y - RandomY, StartPosition.Z - RandomZ)
		end

		Template.Position = StartPosition
		Template.Parent = Workspace
		--Template.BillboardGui.Label.Text = "+"..(Amount).." Wins"
		Template.BillboardGui.Label.Size = UDim2.new()
		local Tween1 = TweenService:Create(Template, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Position = EndPosition})
		Tween1:Play()
		Template.BillboardGui.Label:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.7, 0, .5), 'Out', 'Quad', .1, true)
		local TextTween = TweenService:Create(Template.BillboardGui.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Rotation = 360})
		TextTween:Play()
		task.wait(1)
		local Tween2 = TweenService:Create(Template, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Position = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position})
		Tween2:Play()
		local TextTween2 = TweenService:Create(Template.BillboardGui.Label, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Rotation = 0})
		TextTween2:Play()
		Template.BillboardGui.Label:TweenSize(UDim2.new(), 'Out', 'Quad', .1, true)
		task.wait(.1)
		Tween1:Destroy()
		Tween2:Destroy()
		TextTween:Destroy()
		TextTween2:Destroy()
		Template:Destroy()
	end
end

	PopUpEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Type, Amount)
		if Player.Settings.PopUp.Value == true then
			self:Create(Type, Amount)
		end

-- [Functions] --
function Rebirth:Create(Type, i)
	if Type == "Normal" then
		local New = Template:Clone()
		New.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[i].R).." Rebirths for "..Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[i].C).." Muscle"
		New.Name = tostring(i)
		New.LayoutOrder = i

			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		New.Rebirth.Click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.294, 0, .698), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		Buttton:BindDown(New.Rebirth.Click, function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.285, 0, .677), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		Buttton:BindUp(New.Rebirth.Click, function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
			RebirthEvent:FireServer(i)
		end)
		
		New.Visible = true
		New.Parent = Holder
	elseif Type == "Auto" then
		local New = AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Template:Clone()
		New.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[i].R).." Rebirths for "..Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[i].C).." Muscle"
		New.Name = tostring(i)
		New.LayoutOrder = i
		
		New.Rebirth.Click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		New.Rebirth.Click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.294, 0, .698), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		Buttton:BindDown(New.Rebirth.Click, function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.285, 0, .677), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		end)
		Buttton:BindUp(New.Rebirth.Click, function()
			New.Rebirth:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
			if AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value ~= 0 and AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value ~= i then
				AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder:FindFirstChild(tostring(AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value)).Rebirth.No.Visible = false
				AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder:FindFirstChild(tostring(AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value)).Rebirth.Yes.Visible = true
			end
			AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value = i
			New.Rebirth.Yes.Visible = false
			New.Rebirth.No.Visible = true
		end)
		
		New.Visible = true
		New.Parent = AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder
	end
end

function Rebirth:Update(Type)
	if Type == "Normal" then
		for _,v in ipairs(Holder:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("Frame") then
				if Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].C * ((Player.Stats.Rebirths.Value/2) + 1) < 1000 then
					v.Label.Text = Utility.Round(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].R).." Rebirths for "..Utility.Round(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].C * ((Player.Stats.Rebirths.Value / 2) + 1), 1).." Muscle"
				else
					v.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].R).." Rebirths for "..Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].C * ((Player.Stats.Rebirths.Value / 2) + 1)).." Muscle"
				end
				
				if Player.Stats.Muscle.Value >= Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].C * ((Player.Stats.Rebirths.Value / 2) + 1) then
					v.Rebirth.No.Visible = false
					v.Rebirth.Yes.Visible = true
				else
					v.Rebirth.Yes.Visible = false
					v.Rebirth.No.Visible = true
				end	
			end
		end
	elseif Type == "Auto" then
		for _,v in ipairs(AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("Frame") and v.Name ~= "Disable" then
				v.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].R).." Rebirths for "..Utility.Suffixes(Rebirths[tonumber(v.Name)].C * ((Player.Stats.Rebirths.Value / 2) + 1)).." Muscle"
			end
		end
	end
end

function Rebirth:Disable()
	AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable.Click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
	end)
	AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable.Click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.294, 0, .698), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
	end)
	Buttton:BindDown(AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable.Click, function()
		AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.285, 0, .677), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
	end)
	Buttton:BindUp(AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable.Click, function()
		AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder.Disable.Disable:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.302, 0, .716), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
		if AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value ~= 0 then
			AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder:FindFirstChild(tostring(AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value)).Rebirth.No.Visible = false
			AutoRebirthsFrame.Main.Holder:FindFirstChild(tostring(AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value)).Rebirth.Yes.Visible = true
			AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value = 0
		end
	end)
end

function Rebirth:Int()
	self:Disable()
	for i = 1,#Rebirths do
		self:Create("Normal", i)
		self:Create("Auto", i)
	end
	RebirthsFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if RebirthsFrame.Visible == true then self:Update("Normal") end
	end)
	AutoRebirthsFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if AutoRebirthsFrame.Visible == true then self:Update("Auto") end
	end)
	Player.Stats.Muscle:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if RebirthsFrame.Visible == true then self:Update("Normal") end
		if AutoRebirthsFrame.Visible == true then self:Update("Auto") end
		if AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value ~= 0 then
			if Player.Stats.Muscle.Value >= Rebirths[AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value].C then
				RebirthEvent:FireServer(AutoRebirthsFrame.Selected.Value)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Rebirth

-- [Functions] --
function SuperTest:InRegion()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Objects = {}
		local FoundPlayer = false
		for _,v in pairs(SuperTestFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local Filter = OverlapParams.new()
			
			Filter.FilterDescendantsInstances = {v}
			Filter.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
			
			local CF, Size = v.CFrame, v.Size

			for _,Object in pairs(Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CF, Size, Filter)) do
				if Object.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
					Objects[#Objects + 1] = Object
					if Object.Parent.Name == Player.Name then
						script.InRegion.Value = tonumber(v.Name)
						FoundPlayer = true
					else
						if FoundPlayer == false then
							script.InRegion.Value = 0
						end
					end		
				end
			end
		end
		if #Objects == 0 then
			if FoundPlayer == false then
				script.InRegion.Value = 0
			end
		end
	end)
end

function SuperTest:Update()
	script.InRegion:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
			MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Visible = true
			local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue3.Value) * SuperTestFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Multiplier.Value
			MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Gems.Text = "Cost: "..Utility.Suffixes(Cost).." Boxing"
		else
			MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Visible = false
		end
	end)
	
	local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue3.Value)
	MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Gems.Text = "Cost: "..Utility.Suffixes(Cost).." Boxing"
	MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Strength.Text = "Strength: "..Utility.Suffixes(Player.Stats.Strength.Value)
	Player.Stats.Strength:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
			local Cost = (Player.Stats.FakeValue3.Value) * SuperTestFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Multiplier.Value
			MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Gems.Text = "Cost: "..Utility.Suffixes(Cost).." Boxing"
			MainUI.Bottom.SuperTest.Strength.Text = "Strength: "..Utility.Suffixes(Player.Stats.Strength.Value)
		end
	end)
end

function SuperTest:Animation()
	ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlaySuperTest.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Boxing)
		if LastAnimation == 1 then
			local Tries = 5
			repeat 
				Tries -= 1
				task.wait() 
			until Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)  or Tries <= 0
			if Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name) then		
				if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
					local Items = SuperTestFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Hit:GetChildren()
					local Tween = TweenService:Create(workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name).BodyPosition, TweenInfo.new(.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{Position = Items[math.random(1, #Items)].Position}
					)
					Tween:Play()
				end
			end
			local AnimationTrack = Player.Character.Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			:LoadAnimation(ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlaySuperTest.Left)
			AnimationTrack:Play()
			LastAnimation = 2
		else
			local Tries = 5
			repeat 
				Tries -= 1
				task.wait() 
			until Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)  or Tries <= 0
			if Workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name) then		
				if script.InRegion.Value ~= 0 then
					local Items = SuperTestFolder[script.InRegion.Value].Hit:GetChildren()
					local Tween = TweenService:Create(workspace.Strengths:FindFirstChild(Player.Name).BodyPosition, TweenInfo.new(.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{Position = Items[math.random(1, #Items)].Position}
					)
					Tween:Play()
				end
			end
			local AnimationTrack = Player.Character.Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			:LoadAnimation(ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlaySuperTest.Right)
			AnimationTrack:Play()
			LastAnimation = 1
		end
	end)

	self:Animation()
	self:InRegion()	
	self:Update()
end

function Teleport:Transition()
	task.spawn(function()
		local Border1 = TransitionFrame.border1
		local Border2 = TransitionFrame.border2
		TransitionFrame.Visible = true
		TransitionFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1, 0, 220, 0), 'Out', 'Quad', .5, true)
		task.wait(.5)
		Border1.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)

		Border1.Size = UDim2.new(0.495, 0, 1, 0)
		Border2.Size = UDim2.new(0.495, 0, 1, 0)
		TransitionFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(220, 0, 220, 0), 'Out', 'Quad', .5, true)
		task.wait(.5)
		TransitionFrame.Visible = false
	end)
end

function Teleport:Int()
	for _,v in pairs(Holder:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") then
			Buttton:BindDown(v.Main.Click, function()
				v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.314, 0, .65, 0), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
			end)
			Buttton:BindUp(v.Main.Click, function()
				v.Main:TweenSize(UDim2.new(.337, 0, .698, 0), 'Out', 'Quad', .05, true)
				if v.Main.Buy.Visible == true then
					TeleportEvent:FireServer("Buy", v.Name)
				else
					TeleportEvent:FireServer("Teleport", v.Name)
					LastTeleport = v.Name
				end
			end)
			if TeleportFolder[v.Name].Value == true then
				v.Main.Buy.Visible = false
				v.Main.Teleport.Visible = true
			else
				v.Main.Buy.Visible = true
				v.Main.Teleport.Visible = false
			end
			v.Main.Buy.Label.Text = Utility.Suffixes(TeleportModule[v.Name].Cost)
		end
	end
	for _,v in ipairs(TeleportFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name ~= "Spawn" then
			if v.Value == false then
				Info[v.Name] = true
			end
		end
		v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if v.Value == true then
				Holder[v.Name].Main.Buy.Visible = false
				Holder[v.Name].Main.Teleport.Visible = true
			else
				Holder[v.Name].Main.Buy.Visible = true
				Holder[v.Name].Main.Teleport.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(5)
			for i,v in pairs(TeleportModule) do
				if Info[i] then
					if Player.Stats.Gems.Value >= v.Cost then
						Info[i] = nil
						Error:Create("Success", "You can afford "..i.." Map!")
					end
				end

			end
		end
	end)
	
	TeleportEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ToTeleport)
		self:Transition()
		if Player.Settings.Sounds.Value == true then
			ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Sounds.Teleport:Play()
		end
	end)
	
	Workspace._Water.Touched:Connect(function(Object)
		if Object.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			local PlayerHit = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Object.Parent)
			if PlayerHit and Player then
				if PlayerHit.Name == Player.Name then
					if Transition == true then return end
					Transition = true
					self:Transition()
					task.wait(.3)
					Player.Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(Workspace.Teleport[(LastTeleport or "Spawn")].CFrame)
					task.wait(.5)
					Transition = false
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Teleport

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")

local EMPTY_TABLE = {}
local OFFSET = Vector3.new(0,0.1,0)

local module = {}

module.UpdateQueue = table.create(10)

function module:Init(Settings)
	-- Set defaults
	module.Lifetime = Settings.Lifetime or 3
	module.Direction = Settings.Direction or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
	module.Speed = Settings.Speed or 6
	
	-- Clear any old stuff
	if module.UpdateConnection then
		module.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		module.UpdateConnection = nil
	end
	
	for _, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
		WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
		WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
		WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(module.UpdateQueue)
	
	module.LastSpawned = os.clock()
	local SpawnRate = 1/(Settings.SpawnRate or 25)
	
	-- Setup logic loop
	module.UpdateConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Clock = os.clock()
		
		-- Spawn handler
		if Clock-module.LastSpawned > SpawnRate then
			module:Create()
			module.LastSpawned = Clock
		end
		
		-- Update queue handler
		debug.profilebegin("Wind Lines")
		for i, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
			
			local AliveTime = Clock-WindLine.StartClock
			if AliveTime >= WindLine.Lifetime then
				-- Destroy the objects
				WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
				WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
				WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
				
				-- unordered remove at this index
				local Length = #module.UpdateQueue
				module.UpdateQueue[i] = module.UpdateQueue[Length]
				module.UpdateQueue[Length] = nil
				
				continue
			end
			
			WindLine.Trail.MaxLength = 20 - (20*(AliveTime/WindLine.Lifetime))
			
			local SeededClock = (Clock+WindLine.Seed)*(WindLine.Speed*0.2)
			local StartPos = WindLine.Position
			WindLine.Attachment0.WorldPosition = (
				CFrame.new(StartPos, StartPos+WindLine.Direction) * CFrame.new(0,0,WindLine.Speed * -AliveTime)
			).Position + Vector3.new(math.sin(SeededClock)*0.5,math.sin(SeededClock)*0.8,math.sin(SeededClock)*0.5)
			
			WindLine.Attachment1.WorldPosition = WindLine.Attachment0.WorldPosition + OFFSET
			
		end
		debug.profileend()
	end)


end

function module:Cleanup()
	
	if module.UpdateConnection then
		module.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		module.UpdateConnection = nil
	end

	for _, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
		WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
		WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
		WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(module.UpdateQueue)
	
end

function module:Create(Settings)
	debug.profilebegin("Add Wind Line")
	
	Settings = Settings or EMPTY_TABLE

	local Lifetime = Settings.Lifetime or module.Lifetime
	local Position = Settings.Position or (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-30,70)),math.rad(math.random(-80,80)),0))*CFrame.new(0,0,math.random(200,600)*-0.1).Position
	local Direction = Settings.Direction or module.Direction
	local Speed = Settings.Speed or module.Speed
	if Speed <= 0 then return end

	local Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	local Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	
	local Trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment0
	Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment1
	Trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2,1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8,1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.3),
	})
	Trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.7)
	Trail.FaceCamera = true
	Trail.Parent = Attachment0

	Attachment0.WorldPosition = Position
	Attachment1.WorldPosition = Position+OFFSET
	
	local WindLine = {
		Attachment0 = Attachment0;
		Attachment1 = Attachment1;
		Trail = Trail;
		Lifetime = Lifetime+(math.random(-10,10)*0.1);
		Position = Position;
		Direction = Direction;
		Speed = Speed+(math.random(-10,10)*0.1);
		StartClock = os.clock();
		Seed = math.random(1,1000)*0.1;
	}
	
	module.UpdateQueue[#module.UpdateQueue+1] = WindLine

	Attachment0.Parent = Terrain
	Attachment1.Parent = Terrain
	
	debug.profileend()
end

return module

--[=[

WindShake- High performance wind effect for leaves and foliage
by: boatbomber, CloneTrooper1019

Docs: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/wind-shake-high-performance-wind-effect-for-leaves-and-foliage/1039806/1

--]=]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Settings = require(script.Settings)
local Octree = require(script.Octree)

local COLLECTION_TAG = "WindShake" -- The CollectionService tag to be watched and mounted automatically
local UPDATE_HZ = 1/45 -- Update the object positions at 45 Hz.
local COMPUTE_HZ = 1/30 -- Compute the object targets at 30 Hz.

-- Use the script's attributes as the default settings.
-- The table provided is a fallback if the attributes
-- are undefined or using the wrong value types.

local DEFAULT_SETTINGS = Settings.new(script, {
	WindDirection = Vector3.new(0.5, 0, 0.5);
	WindSpeed = 20;
	WindPower = 0.5;
})

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local ObjectShakeAddedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ObjectShakeRemovedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local PausedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ResumedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

local WindShake = {
	ObjectMetadata = {};
	Octree = Octree.new();

	Handled = 0;
	Active = 0;
	LastUpdate = os.clock();

	ObjectShakeAdded = ObjectShakeAddedEvent.Event;
	ObjectShakeRemoved = ObjectShakeRemovedEvent.Event;
	ObjectShakeUpdated = ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent.Event;
	Paused = PausedEvent.Event;
	Resumed = ResumedEvent.Event;

}

export type WindShakeSettings = {
	WindDirection: Vector3?,
	WindSpeed: number?,
	WindPower: number?,
}

function WindShake:Connect(funcName: string, event: RBXScriptSignal): RBXScriptConnection
	local callback = self[funcName]
	assert(typeof(callback) == "function", "Unknown function: " .. funcName)

	return event:Connect(function (...)
		return callback(self, ...)
	end)
end

function WindShake:AddObjectShake(object: BasePart, settingsTable: WindShakeSettings?)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	if not object:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	local metadata = self.ObjectMetadata

	if metadata[object] then
		return
	else
		self.Handled += 1
	end

	metadata[object] = {
		Node = self.Octree:CreateNode(object.Position, object);
		Settings = Settings.new(object, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);

		Seed = math.random(1000) * 0.1;
		Origin = object.CFrame;
	}

	self:UpdateObjectSettings(object, settingsTable)

	ObjectShakeAddedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:RemoveObjectShake(object: BasePart)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	local metadata = self.ObjectMetadata
	local objMeta = metadata[object]

	if objMeta then
		self.Handled -= 1
		metadata[object] = nil
		objMeta.Settings:Destroy()
		objMeta.Node:Destroy()

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.CFrame = objMeta.Origin
		end
	end

	ObjectShakeRemovedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:Update()
	local now = os.clock()
	local dt = now - self.LastUpdate

	if dt < UPDATE_HZ then
		return
	end

	self.LastUpdate = now

	debug.profilebegin("WindShake")

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraCF = camera and camera.CFrame

	debug.profilebegin("Octree Search")
	local updateObjects = self.Octree:RadiusSearch(cameraCF.Position + (cameraCF.LookVector * 115), 120)
	debug.profileend()

	local activeCount = #updateObjects

	self.Active = activeCount

	if activeCount < 1 then
		return
	end

	local step = math.min(1, dt * 8)
	local cfTable = table.create(activeCount)
	local objectMetadata = self.ObjectMetadata

	debug.profilebegin("Calc")
	for i, object in ipairs(updateObjects) do
		local objMeta = objectMetadata[object]
		local lastComp = objMeta.LastCompute or 0

		local origin = objMeta.Origin
		local current = objMeta.CFrame or origin

		if (now - lastComp) > COMPUTE_HZ then
			local objSettings = objMeta.Settings

			local seed = objMeta.Seed
			local amp = objSettings.WindPower * 0.1

			local freq = now * (objSettings.WindSpeed * 0.08)
			local rotX = math.noise(freq, 0, seed) * amp
			local rotY = math.noise(freq, 0, -seed) * amp
			local rotZ = math.noise(freq, 0, seed+seed) * amp
			local offset = object.PivotOffset
			local worldpivot = origin * offset

			objMeta.Target = (worldpivot * CFrame.Angles(rotX, rotY, rotZ) + objSettings.WindDirection * ((0.5 + math.noise(freq, seed, seed)) * amp)) * offset:Inverse()

			objMeta.LastCompute = now
		end

		current = current:Lerp(objMeta.Target, step)
		objMeta.CFrame = current
		cfTable[i] = current
	end
	debug.profileend()

	workspace:BulkMoveTo(updateObjects, cfTable, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	debug.profileend()
end

function WindShake:Pause()
	if self.UpdateConnection then
		self.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		self.UpdateConnection = nil
	end

	self.Active = 0
	self.Running = false

	PausedEvent:Fire()
end

function WindShake:Resume()
	if self.Running then
		return
	else
		self.Running = true
	end

	-- Connect updater
	self.UpdateConnection = self:Connect("Update", RunService.Heartbeat)

	ResumedEvent:Fire()
end

function WindShake:Init()
	if self.Initialized then
		return
	else
		self.Initialized = true
	end

	-- Define attributes if they're undefined.
	local Power = script:GetAttribute("WindPower")
	local speed = script:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
	local direction = script:GetAttribute("WindDirection")

	if typeof(Power) ~= "number" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindPower", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindPower)
	end

	if typeof(speed) ~= "number" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindSpeed", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindSpeed)
	end

	if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindDirection", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindDirection)
	end

	-- Clear any old stuff.
	self:Cleanup()

	-- Wire up tag listeners.
	local windShakeAdded = CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(COLLECTION_TAG)
	self.AddedConnection = self:Connect("AddObjectShake", windShakeAdded)

	local windShakeRemoved = CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(COLLECTION_TAG)
	self.RemovedConnection = self:Connect("RemoveObjectShake", windShakeRemoved)

	for _,object in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(COLLECTION_TAG)) do
		self:AddObjectShake(object)
	end

	-- Automatically start.
	self:Resume()
end

function WindShake:Cleanup()
	if not self.Initialized then
		return
	end

	self:Pause()

	if self.AddedConnection then
		self.AddedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.AddedConnection = nil
	end

	if self.RemovedConnection then
		self.RemovedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.RemovedConnection = nil
	end

	table.clear(self.ObjectMetadata)
	self.Octree:ClearNodes()

	self.Handled = 0
	self.Active = 0
	self.Initialized = false
end

function WindShake:UpdateObjectSettings(object: Instance, settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	if typeof(settingsTable) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if (not self.ObjectMetadata[object]) and (object ~= script) then
		return
	end

	for key, value in pairs(settingsTable) do
		object:SetAttribute(key, value)
	end

	ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:UpdateAllObjectSettings(settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	if typeof(settingsTable) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	for obj, objMeta in pairs(self.ObjectMetadata) do
		for key, value in pairs(settingsTable) do
			obj:SetAttribute(key, value)
		end
		ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent:Fire(obj)
	end
end

function WindShake:SetDefaultSettings(settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	self:UpdateObjectSettings(script, settingsTable)
end

return WindShake

local OctreeNode = require(script.OctreeNode)
local OctreeRegionUtils = require(script.OctreeRegionUtils)

local EPSILON = 1e-9
local SQRT_3_OVER_2 = math.sqrt(3) / 2
local SUB_REGION_POSITION_OFFSET = {
	{0.25, 0.25, -0.25};
	{-0.25, 0.25, -0.25};
	{0.25, 0.25, 0.25};
	{-0.25, 0.25, 0.25};
	{0.25, -0.25, -0.25};
	{-0.25, -0.25, -0.25};
	{0.25, -0.25, 0.25};
	{-0.25, -0.25, 0.25};
}

local Octree = {ClassName = "Octree"}
Octree.__index = Octree

local OctreeNode_new = OctreeNode.new
local OctreeRegionUtils_GetNeighborsWithinRadius = OctreeRegionUtils.GetNeighborsWithinRadius

function Octree.new()
	return setmetatable({
		MaxDepth = 4;
		MaxRegionSize = table.create(3, 512);
		RegionHashMap = {};
	}, Octree)
end

function Octree:ClearNodes()
	self.MaxDepth = 4
	self.MaxRegionSize = table.create(3, 512)
	table.clear(self.RegionHashMap)
end

function Octree:GetAllNodes()
	local Options = {}
	local Length = 0

	for _, RegionList in next, self.RegionHashMap do
		for _, Region in ipairs(RegionList) do
			for Node in next, Region.Nodes do
				Length += 1
				Options[Length] = Node
			end
		end
	end

	return Options
end

function Octree:CreateNode(Position: Vector3, Object)
	if typeof(Position) ~= "Vector3" then
		error("Bad position value")
	end

	if not Object then
		error("Bad object value.")
	end

	local Node = OctreeNode_new(self, Object)
	Node:SetPosition(Position)
	return Node
end

function Octree:RadiusSearch(Position: Vector3, Radius: number)
	if typeof(Position) ~= "Vector3" then
		error("Bad position value")
	end

	if type(Radius) ~= "number" then
		error("Bad radius value")
	end

	local PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ = Position.X, Position.Y, Position.Z
	local ObjectsFound = {}
	local NodeDistances2 = {}
	local ObjectsLength = 0
	local DistancesLength = 0

	local Diameter = self.MaxRegionSize[1]
	local SearchRadius = Radius + SQRT_3_OVER_2 * Diameter
	local SearchRadiusSquared = SearchRadius * SearchRadius + EPSILON

	for _, RegionList in next, self.RegionHashMap do
		for _, Region in ipairs(RegionList) do
			local RegionPosition = Region.Position
			local RegionPositionX = RegionPosition[1]
			local RegionPositionY = RegionPosition[2]
			local RegionPositionZ = RegionPosition[3]

			local OffsetX, OffsetY, OffsetZ = PositionX - RegionPositionX, PositionY - RegionPositionY, PositionZ - RegionPositionZ
			local Distance2 = OffsetX * OffsetX + OffsetY * OffsetY + OffsetZ * OffsetZ

			if Distance2 <= SearchRadiusSquared then
				ObjectsLength, DistancesLength = OctreeRegionUtils_GetNeighborsWithinRadius(Region, Radius, PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ, ObjectsFound, NodeDistances2, self.MaxDepth, ObjectsLength, DistancesLength)
			end
		end
	end

	return ObjectsFound, NodeDistances2
end

local function NearestNeighborSort(A, B)
	return A.Distance2 < B.Distance2
end

function Octree:KNearestNeighborsSearch(Position: Vector3, K: number, Radius: number)
	if typeof(Position) ~= "Vector3" then
		error("Bad position value")
	end

	if type(Radius) ~= "number" then
		error("Bad radius value")
	end

	local PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ = Position.X, Position.Y, Position.Z
	local Objects = {}
	local NodeDistances2 = {}
	local ObjectsLength = 0
	local DistancesLength = 0

	local Diameter = self.MaxRegionSize[1]
	local SearchRadius = Radius + SQRT_3_OVER_2 * Diameter
	local SearchRadiusSquared = SearchRadius * SearchRadius + EPSILON

	for _, RegionList in next, self.RegionHashMap do
		for _, Region in ipairs(RegionList) do
			local RegionPosition = Region.Position
			local RegionPositionX = RegionPosition[1]
			local RegionPositionY = RegionPosition[2]
			local RegionPositionZ = RegionPosition[3]

			local OffsetX, OffsetY, OffsetZ = PositionX - RegionPositionX, PositionY - RegionPositionY, PositionZ - RegionPositionZ
			local Distance2 = OffsetX * OffsetX + OffsetY * OffsetY + OffsetZ * OffsetZ

			if Distance2 <= SearchRadiusSquared then
				ObjectsLength, DistancesLength = OctreeRegionUtils_GetNeighborsWithinRadius(Region, Radius, PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ, Objects, NodeDistances2, self.MaxDepth, ObjectsLength, DistancesLength)
			end
		end
	end

	local Sortable = table.create(DistancesLength)
	for Index, Distance2 in ipairs(NodeDistances2) do
		Sortable[Index] = {
			Distance2 = Distance2;
			Index = Index;
		}
	end

	table.sort(Sortable, NearestNeighborSort)

	local ArrayLength = math.min(DistancesLength, K)
	local KNearest = table.create(ArrayLength)
	local KNearestDistance2 = table.create(ArrayLength)
	for Index = 1, ArrayLength do
		local Sorted = Sortable[Index]
		KNearestDistance2[Index] = Sorted.Distance2
		KNearest[Index] = Objects[Sorted.Index]
	end

	return KNearest, KNearestDistance2
end

local function GetOrCreateRegion(self, PositionX: number, PositionY: number, PositionZ: number)
	local RegionHashMap = self.RegionHashMap
	local MaxRegionSize = self.MaxRegionSize
	local X, Y, Z = MaxRegionSize[1], MaxRegionSize[2], MaxRegionSize[3]
	local CX, CY, CZ = math.floor(PositionX / X + 0.5), math.floor(PositionY / Y + 0.5), math.floor(PositionZ / Z + 0.5)
	local Hash = CX * 73856093 + CY * 19351301 + CZ * 83492791

	local RegionList = RegionHashMap[Hash]
	if not RegionList then
		RegionList = {}
		RegionHashMap[Hash] = RegionList
	end

	local RegionPositionX, RegionPositionY, RegionPositionZ = X * CX, Y * CY, Z * CZ
	for _, Region in ipairs(RegionList) do
		local Position = Region.Position
		if Position[1] == RegionPositionX and Position[2] == RegionPositionY and Position[3] == RegionPositionZ then
			return Region
		end
	end

	local HalfSizeX, HalfSizeY, HalfSizeZ = X / 2, Y / 2, Z / 2

	local LowerBoundsArray = {RegionPositionX - HalfSizeX, RegionPositionY - HalfSizeY, RegionPositionZ - HalfSizeZ}
	local PositionArray = {RegionPositionX, RegionPositionY, RegionPositionZ}
	local SizeArray = {X, Y, Z}
	local UpperBoundsArray = {RegionPositionX + HalfSizeX, RegionPositionY + HalfSizeY, RegionPositionZ + HalfSizeZ}

	local Region = {
		Depth = 1;
		LowerBounds = LowerBoundsArray;
		NodeCount = 0;
		Nodes = {}; -- [node] = true (contains subchild nodes too)
		Parent = nil;
		ParentIndex = nil;
		Position = PositionArray;
		Size = SizeArray; -- { sx, sy, sz }
		SubRegions = {};
		UpperBounds = UpperBoundsArray;
	}

	table.insert(RegionList, Region)
	return Region
end

function Octree:GetOrCreateLowestSubRegion(PositionX: number, PositionY: number, PositionZ: number)
	local Region = GetOrCreateRegion(self, PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ)
	local MaxDepth = self.MaxDepth
	local Current = Region
	for _ = Region.Depth, MaxDepth do
		local CurrentPosition = Current.Position
		local Index = PositionX > CurrentPosition[1] and 1 or 2
		if PositionY <= CurrentPosition[2] then
			Index += 4
		end

		if PositionZ >= CurrentPosition[3] then
			Index += 2
		end

		local SubRegions = Current.SubRegions
		local Next = SubRegions[Index]

		-- construct
		if not Next then
			local Size = Current.Size
			local Multiplier = SUB_REGION_POSITION_OFFSET[Index]

			local X, Y, Z = Size[1], Size[2], Size[3]
			local CurrentPositionX = CurrentPosition[1] + Multiplier[1] * X
			local CurrentPositionY = CurrentPosition[2] + Multiplier[2] * Y
			local CurrentPositionZ = CurrentPosition[3] + Multiplier[3] * Z
			local SizeX, SizeY, SizeZ = X / 2, Y / 2, Z / 2

			local HalfSizeX, HalfSizeY, HalfSizeZ = SizeX / 2, SizeY / 2, SizeZ / 2

			local LowerBoundsArray = {CurrentPositionX - HalfSizeX, CurrentPositionY - HalfSizeY, CurrentPositionZ - HalfSizeZ}
			local PositionArray = {CurrentPositionX, CurrentPositionY, CurrentPositionZ}
			local SizeArray = {SizeX, SizeY, SizeZ}
			local UpperBoundsArray = {CurrentPositionX + HalfSizeX, CurrentPositionY + HalfSizeY, CurrentPositionZ + HalfSizeZ}

			Next = {
				Depth = Current and (Current.Depth + 1) or 1;
				LowerBounds = LowerBoundsArray;
				NodeCount = 0;
				Nodes = {}; -- [node] = true (contains subchild nodes too)
				Parent = Current;
				ParentIndex = Index;
				Position = PositionArray;
				Size = SizeArray; -- { sx, sy, sz }
				SubRegions = {};
				UpperBounds = UpperBoundsArray;
			}

			-- Next = OctreeRegionUtils.CreateSubRegion(Current, Index)
			SubRegions[Index] = Next
		end

		-- iterate
		Current = Next
	end

	return Current
end

return Octree

--- Basic node interacting with the octree
-- @classmod OctreeNode

local OctreeNode = {ClassName = "OctreeNode"}
OctreeNode.__index = OctreeNode

function OctreeNode.new(Octree, Object)
	return setmetatable({
		Octree = Octree or error("No octree");
		Object = Object or error("No object");

		CurrentLowestRegion = nil;
		Position = nil;
		PositionX = nil;
		PositionY = nil;
		PositionZ = nil;
	}, OctreeNode)
end

function OctreeNode:KNearestNeighborsSearch(K: number, Radius: number)
	return self.Octree:KNearestNeighborsSearch(self.Position, K, Radius)
end

function OctreeNode:GetObject()
	warn("OctreeNode:GetObject is deprecated.")
	return self.Object
end

function OctreeNode:RadiusSearch(Radius: number)
	return self.Octree:RadiusSearch(self.Position, Radius)
end

function OctreeNode:GetPosition()
	warn("OctreeNode:GetPosition is deprecated.")
	return self.Position
end

function OctreeNode:GetRawPosition(): (number, number, number)
	return self.PositionX, self.PositionY, self.PositionZ
end

function OctreeNode:SetPosition(Position: Vector3)
	if self.Position == Position then
		return
	end

	local PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ = Position.X, Position.Y, Position.Z

	self.PositionX = PositionX
	self.PositionY = PositionY
	self.PositionZ = PositionZ
	self.Position = Position

	if self.CurrentLowestRegion then
		local Region = self.CurrentLowestRegion
		local LowerBounds = Region.LowerBounds
		local UpperBounds = Region.UpperBounds
		if PositionX >= LowerBounds[1] and PositionX <= UpperBounds[1] and PositionY >= LowerBounds[2] and PositionY <= UpperBounds[2] and PositionZ >= LowerBounds[3] and PositionZ <= UpperBounds[3] then
			return
		end
	end

	local NewLowestRegion = self.Octree:GetOrCreateLowestSubRegion(PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ)
	if self.CurrentLowestRegion then
		-- OctreeRegionUtils_MoveNode(self.CurrentLowestRegion, NewLowestRegion, self)
		local FromLowest = self.CurrentLowestRegion
		if FromLowest.Depth ~= NewLowestRegion.Depth then
			error("fromLowest.Depth ~= toLowest.Depth")
		end

		if FromLowest == NewLowestRegion then
			error("fromLowest == toLowest")
		end

		local CurrentFrom = FromLowest
		local CurrentTo = NewLowestRegion

		while CurrentFrom ~= CurrentTo do
			-- remove from current
			local CurrentFromNodes = CurrentFrom.Nodes
			if not CurrentFromNodes[self] then
				error("CurrentFrom.Nodes doesn't have a node here.")
			end

			local NodeCount = CurrentFrom.NodeCount
			if NodeCount <= 0 then
				error("NodeCount is <= 0.")
			end

			NodeCount -= 1
			CurrentFromNodes[self] = nil
			CurrentFrom.NodeCount = NodeCount

			-- remove subregion!
			local ParentIndex = CurrentFrom.ParentIndex
			if NodeCount <= 0 and ParentIndex then
				local Parent = CurrentFrom.Parent
				if not Parent then
					error("CurrentFrom.Parent doesn't exist.")
				end

				local SubRegions = Parent.SubRegions
				if SubRegions[ParentIndex] ~= CurrentFrom then
					error("Failed equality check.")
				end

				SubRegions[ParentIndex] = nil
			end

			local CurrentToNodes = CurrentTo.Nodes
			if CurrentToNodes[self] then
				error("CurrentTo.Nodes already has a node here.")
			end

			CurrentToNodes[self] = self
			CurrentTo.NodeCount += 1

			CurrentFrom = CurrentFrom.Parent
			CurrentTo = CurrentTo.Parent
		end
	else
		local Current = NewLowestRegion
		while Current do
			local CurrentNodes = Current.Nodes
			if not CurrentNodes[self] then
				CurrentNodes[self] = self
				Current.NodeCount += 1
			end

			Current = Current.Parent
		end
	end

	self.CurrentLowestRegion = NewLowestRegion
end

function OctreeNode:Destroy()
	local LowestSubregion = self.CurrentLowestRegion
	if LowestSubregion then
		local Current = LowestSubregion

		while Current do
			local Nodes = Current.Nodes
			if not Nodes[self] then
				error("CurrentFrom.Nodes doesn't have a node here.")
			end

			local NodeCount = Current.NodeCount
			if NodeCount <= 0 then
				error("NodeCount is <= 0.")
			end

			NodeCount -= 1
			Nodes[self] = nil
			Current.NodeCount = NodeCount

			-- remove subregion!
			local Parent = Current.Parent
			local ParentIndex = Current.ParentIndex
			if NodeCount <= 0 and ParentIndex then
				if not Parent then
					error("Current.Parent doesn't exist.")
				end

				local SubRegions = Parent.SubRegions
				if SubRegions[ParentIndex] ~= Current then
					error("Failed equality check.")
				end

				SubRegions[ParentIndex] = nil
			end

			Current = Parent
		end
	end
end

return OctreeNode

--- Octree implementation
-- @module OctreeRegionUtils

local EPSILON = 1e-6
local SQRT_3_OVER_2 = math.sqrt(3) / 2
local SUB_REGION_POSITION_OFFSET = {
	{0.25, 0.25, -0.25};
	{-0.25, 0.25, -0.25};
	{0.25, 0.25, 0.25};
	{-0.25, 0.25, 0.25};
	{0.25, -0.25, -0.25};
	{-0.25, -0.25, -0.25};
	{0.25, -0.25, 0.25};
	{-0.25, -0.25, 0.25};
}

local OctreeRegionUtils = {}

-- See basic algorithm:
-- luacheck: push ignore
-- https://github.com/PointCloudLibrary/pcl/blob/29f192af57a3e7bdde6ff490669b211d8148378f/octree/include/pcl/octree/impl/octree_search.hpp#L309
-- luacheck: pop
local function GetNeighborsWithinRadius(Region, Radius, PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ, ObjectsFound, NodeDistances2, MaxDepth, ObjectsLength, DistancesLength)
	if not MaxDepth then
		error("Missing MaxDepth.")
	end

	local SearchRadius = Radius + SQRT_3_OVER_2 * (Region.Size[1] / 2)
	local SearchRadiusSquared = SearchRadius * SearchRadius + EPSILON
	local RadiusSquared = Radius * Radius

	-- for each child
	for _, ChildRegion in next, Region.SubRegions do
		local ChildPosition = ChildRegion.Position
		local ChildPositionX = ChildPosition[1]
		local ChildPositionY = ChildPosition[2]
		local ChildPositionZ = ChildPosition[3]

		local OffsetX = PositionX - ChildPositionX
		local OffsetY = PositionY - ChildPositionY
		local OffsetZ = PositionZ - ChildPositionZ
		local Distance2 = OffsetX * OffsetX + OffsetY * OffsetY + OffsetZ * OffsetZ

		-- within search radius
		if Distance2 <= SearchRadiusSquared then
			if ChildRegion.Depth == MaxDepth then
				for Node in next, ChildRegion.Nodes do
					local NodePositionX = Node.PositionX
					local NodePositionY = Node.PositionY
					local NodePositionZ = Node.PositionZ

					local NodeOffsetX = NodePositionX - PositionX
					local NodeOffsetY = NodePositionY - PositionY
					local NodeOffsetZ = NodePositionZ - PositionZ
					local NodeDistance2 = NodeOffsetX * NodeOffsetX + NodeOffsetY * NodeOffsetY + NodeOffsetZ * NodeOffsetZ

					if NodeDistance2 <= RadiusSquared then
						ObjectsLength += 1
						DistancesLength += 1
						ObjectsFound[ObjectsLength] = Node.Object
						NodeDistances2[DistancesLength] = NodeDistance2
					end
				end
			else
				ObjectsLength, DistancesLength = GetNeighborsWithinRadius(ChildRegion, Radius, PositionX, PositionY, PositionZ, ObjectsFound, NodeDistances2, MaxDepth, ObjectsLength, DistancesLength)
			end
		end
	end

	return ObjectsLength, DistancesLength
end

OctreeRegionUtils.GetNeighborsWithinRadius = GetNeighborsWithinRadius
return OctreeRegionUtils

local Settings = {}

	WindPower = "number";
	WindSpeed = "number";

function Settings.new(object, base)
	local inst = table.create(3)

	-- Initial settings

	local WindPower = object:GetAttribute("WindPower")
	local WindSpeed = object:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
	local WindDirection = object:GetAttribute("WindDirection")

	inst.WindPower = typeof(WindPower) == SettingTypes.WindPower and WindPower or base.WindPower
	inst.WindSpeed = typeof(WindSpeed) == SettingTypes.WindSpeed and WindSpeed or base.WindSpeed
	inst.WindDirection = typeof(WindDirection) == SettingTypes.WindDirection and WindDirection or base.WindDirection

	-- Update settings on event

	local PowerConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindPower"):Connect(function()
		WindPower = object:GetAttribute("WindPower")
		inst.WindPower = typeof(WindPower) == SettingTypes.WindPower and WindPower or base.WindPower
	end)

	local SpeedConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindSpeed"):Connect(function()
		WindSpeed = object:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
		inst.WindSpeed = typeof(WindSpeed) == SettingTypes.WindSpeed and WindSpeed or base.WindSpeed
	end)

	local DirectionConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindDirection"):Connect(function()
		WindDirection = object:GetAttribute("WindDirection")
		inst.WindDirection = typeof(WindDirection) == SettingTypes.WindDirection and WindDirection or base.WindDirection
	end)

	-- Cleanup function for when shake is removed or object is unloaded

	function inst:Destroy()
		PowerConnection:Disconnect()
		SpeedConnection:Disconnect()
		DirectionConnection:Disconnect()
		table.clear(inst)
	end

	return inst
end

		end
		for absolute_x, gui_objs in pairs(absolutes) do -- loop thru the absolutes
			if #gui_objs > amount then -- if this absolute_y has more frames than the current amount then, update the horizontal amount
				amount = #gui_objs
			end
		end
		return amount -- return the current horizontal amount.
	end
	
	function AutoCanvasSize.Disconnect(for_scroller)
		if connections[for_scroller] then
			for i=1, #connections[for_scroller] do
				local connection = connections[for_scroller][i]
				if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
			end
			connections[for_scroller] = nil
		end
	end

	function AutoCanvasSize.Connect(scroller, only_y)
		only_y = only_y~=nil and only_y or true
		local layout = scroller:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout") or scroller:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout")
--		local grid = scroller:WaitForChild("UIGridLayout")
		local function GetGuiObjects()
			local objs = {}
			local c = scroller:GetChildren()
			for i=1, #c do
				local o = c[i]
				if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
					table.insert(objs,o)
				end
			end
			return objs
		end
		
		-- updates the CanvasSize based on the amount of frames in the frame, along with
		local function Update()
			scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,only_y and 0 or layout.AbsoluteContentSize.X,0,layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 25)
		end
		connections[scroller] = {
			layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(Update),
			scroller.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if not scroller.Parent then
					AutoCanvasSize.Disconnect(scroller)
				end
			end),
			scroller.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
				spawn(Update) -- it appears the child does not get added until the connection returns (or something of that effect)
							  -- so, we spawn the Update so it is inclusive of the new child.
			end),
			scroller.ChildRemoved:Connect(Update)
		}
		Update()
	end
	
return AutoCanvasSize

-- Encodes and decodes values to and from Base64
-- @author antifragileer <https://www.roblox.com/users/443282130/profile>
-- @see Developed for the Aero Game Framework <https://github.com/Sleitnick/AeroGameFramework>
-- @see Adapted from https://github.com/toastdriven/lua-base64 for the Roblox game.
-- @license BSD
-- July 15, 2018

--[[
	
	local base64 = Base64.new()
	
	Example:
	
	local myEncodedWord = base64:Encode("Hello")
	
	print(myEncodedWord)
	
	-- outputs: SGVsbG8=
	
	print(base64:Decode(myEncodedWord))
	
	-- outputs: Hello

--]]


local Base64 = {}
Base64.__index = Base64

local sub = string.sub
local byte = string.byte
local char = string.char
local gsub = string.gsub
local find = string.find

--- Object constructor
-- @return Base64
function Base64.new()
	
	local self = setmetatable({
		IndexTable = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
	}, Base64)
	
	return self
	
end

--- Converts an integer to binary
-- @private
-- @param number Integer
-- @return string
function Base64:__BinaryEncode(Integer)
	
	local Remaining = tonumber(Integer)
	local BinaryBits = ''

	for i = 7, 0, -1 do
		local CurrentPower = 2 ^ i

		if Remaining >= CurrentPower then
			BinaryBits = BinaryBits .. '1'
			Remaining = Remaining - CurrentPower
		else
			BinaryBits = BinaryBits .. '0'
		end
	end

	return BinaryBits
	
end

--- Converts a binary bit to a number
-- @private
-- @param string BinaryBits
-- @return number
function Base64:__BinaryDecode(BinaryBits)
	
	return tonumber(BinaryBits, 2)
	
end

--- Converts a string or number to a Base64 value
-- @public
-- @param string|number Value
-- @return string
function Base64:Encode(Value)

	local BitPattern = ''
	local Encoded = ''
	local Trailing = ''

	for i = 1, #Value do
		BitPattern = BitPattern .. self:__BinaryEncode(byte(sub(Value, i, i)))
	end

	-- Check the number of bytes. If it's not evenly divisible by three,
	-- zero-pad the ending & append on the correct number of ``=``s.
	if #BitPattern % 3 == 2 then
		Trailing = '=='
		BitPattern = BitPattern .. '0000000000000000'
	elseif #BitPattern % 3 == 1 then
		Trailing = '='
		BitPattern = BitPattern .. '00000000'
	end

	for i = 1, #BitPattern, 6 do
		local Byte = sub(BitPattern, i, i+5)
		local Offset = tonumber(self:__BinaryDecode(Byte))
		
		Encoded = Encoded .. sub(self.IndexTable, Offset+1, Offset+1)
	end

	return sub(Encoded, 1, -1 - #Trailing) .. Trailing

end

--- Converts a Base64 encoded string to its original value
-- @public
-- @param string Value
-- @return string
function Base64:Decode(Value)
	
	local Padded = gsub(Value, "%s", "")
	local Unpadded = gsub(Padded, "=", "")
	local BitPattern = ''
	local Decoded = ''

	for i = 1, #Unpadded do
		local Char = sub(Value, i, i)
		local Offset, _ = find(self.IndexTable, Char)

		if Offset == nil then
			error("Invalid character \"" .. Char .. "\" found.")
		end

		BitPattern = BitPattern .. sub(self:__BinaryEncode(Offset-1), 3)
	end

	for i = 1, #BitPattern, 8 do
		local Byte = sub(BitPattern, i, i+7)

		Decoded = Decoded .. char(self:__BinaryDecode(Byte))
	end

	local PaddingLength = #Padded-#Unpadded

	if (PaddingLength == 1 or PaddingLength == 2) then
		Decoded = sub(Decoded, 1,-2)
	end

	return Decoded

end


return Base64
